plugins.description: Control running DeepSeek Harness sessions from desktop and mobile browsers using the stock DSH Web UI and a self-hosted relay.
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH Web Control

[English](README.en.md) · [安装](docs/installation.md) · [部署 Relay](docs/deployment.md) · [版本与限制](docs/compatibility.md) · [Releases](https://github.com/liangkw16/dsh-web-control/releases)

通过链接或二维码，在电脑、平板和手机浏览器中接管正在运行的 DeepSeek Harness 会话。

**尽可能复用 DSH 原版 Web UI，Web Control 只负责认证、连接与有限能力桥接。** 无需开放电脑的入站端口，无需远程桌面。

这是独立社区插件，与 DeepSeek 没有隶属或官方背书关系。当前版本 **v0.1.0**，验证目标为 **DSH 0.2.0-rc.2**；其他 DSH 版本未声明兼容。Relay 需自行部署，本项目不提供公共托管服务。

## 能做什么

- 原版会话列表、消息、执行进度、工具记录、队列操作和审批交互。
- 在电脑与移动浏览器间切换，新页面可接替旧控制页面。
- 原版文件卡片、历史 diff、侧栏标签和完整文件预览；支持浏览器下载与上传。
- 插件在 DSH Host 中保持连接，关闭设置页面或仅锁屏后仍可使用；休眠、断网和退出 DSH 会影响连接。
- 通过版本协商和明确的命令接口适配，保留 DSH 原版业务资源，避免维护另一套聊天界面。

## 工作方式

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    Browser[PC / 移动浏览器] <-->|HTTPS / WSS| Relay[自托管 Relay]
    Host[DSH Host + 插件] <-->|主动建立 WSS| Relay
    Host --> Session[原版会话与工作区服务]
```

Relay 负责认证、路由和静态 UI 分发。浏览器与 Host 均通过 TLS 连接到 Relay，**不是端到端加密**：部署者必须信任自己的 Relay。控制链接是访问凭据，不要公开分享。

## 快速开始

1. 从 [v0.1.0 Release](https://github.com/liangkw16/dsh-web-control/releases/tag/v0.1.0) 下载插件 `dsh-web-control-0.1.0.tgz`、部署包及 `SHA256SUMS`，按[部署指南](docs/deployment.md)启动 HTTPS Relay。
2. 在 DSH 桌面 App 的「插件 → 添加插件」中安装下载的 `.tgz`，启用插件。CLI 用户可运行：

   ```sh
   npx @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.0-rc.2 plugin --profile web add ./dsh-web-control-0.1.0.tgz
   ```

3. 首次使用时，由 Relay 管理者生成一次私有连接配置，在 DSH「设置 → 网页远控」导入；日常使用只需打开生成的链接或扫码。
4. 保持 DSH 运行，在另一台设备的浏览器打开链接即可。停止远控、刷新链接与接管规则见[安装指南](docs/installation.md)。

预构建 tarball 不需要在安装时执行构建脚本。源码仓库是 monorepo；不要把仓库根目录当成可直接安装的插件包。

## 文档

| 文档 | 内容 |
| --- | --- |
| [安装与配对](docs/installation.md) | 桌面 / CLI、首次配置、控制链接、升级卸载 |
| [Relay 部署](docs/deployment.md) | Docker Compose、HTTPS、IP:port、备份回退 |
| [架构](docs/architecture.md) | 原版 UI 复用、状态同步和权限边界 |
| [兼容性](docs/compatibility.md) | 支持范围、文件限制、浏览器验收边界 |
| [排障](docs/troubleshooting.md) | 连接、证书、文件读取与锁屏 |
| [贡献指南](CONTRIBUTING.md) | 构建、测试、PR 要求 |
| [发布流程](docs/releasing.md) | 制品、校验、验证与官方发现入口 |
| [安全政策](SECURITY.md) | 威胁模型、漏洞报告、凭据保护 |

## 本地开发

需要 Node.js 24.x、pnpm 11.25.0。运行测试只使用隔离 fixture，不连接你的生产 DSH。

```sh
corepack enable
corepack prepare pnpm@11.25.0 --activate
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm build
pnpm typecheck
pnpm test
```

Relay 镜像还需要固定的原版 UI 资源；不能只运行 `docker build`。使用完整部署包，或按[发布流程](docs/releasing.md)组装 `release-input/web`。

## 许可证与来源

本项目使用 [MIT](LICENSE)。DeepSeek Harness 和其他依赖保留各自许可证，见 [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)。原版 UI 资源的许可证随部署包分发。

DeepSeek [官网](https://deepseek.com/harness/)的“社区插件”指向 GitHub [`dsh-plugin` topic](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)，这是本项目采用的官方发现路径；不是“官方审核通过”的标志。

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness A2A (Agent2Agent) plugin: expose DSH agents as standard A2A servers (agent card, message/send, message/stream SSE, tasks) + a2a_* tools to call remote A2A agents
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-a2a

DSH（DeepSeek Harness）的 **A2A（Agent2Agent）协议**插件。

DSH 内置的互操作走 ACP + MCP，不包含 A2A；本插件补上这块拼图，**双向**打通 A2A 生态（Google ADK、a2ajava / a2a-python SDK、各类 agent 网关）：

- **服务器方向（入站）**：把 DSH agent 暴露为标准 A2A 服务器
  - Agent Card：`/.well-known/agent-card.json`（0.3.x）与 `/.well-known/agent.json`（0.2.x 兼容）
  - JSON-RPC 2.0：`message/send`（同步）、`message/stream`（SSE 流式）、`tasks/get`、`tasks/cancel`、`tasks/resubscribe`（断线续订）、`agent/authenticatedExtendedCard`
  - 任务生命周期 `submitted → working → completed/failed/canceled`，支持 `input-required` 暂停与 taskId 多轮续答
  - 版本协商（`A2A-Version` / `X-A2A-Version` 头）、可选 Bearer 鉴权、CORS、单轮超时、任务 TTL 回收
- **客户端方向（出站）**：注册 `a2a_*` 模型工具，让任意 DSH agent 直接呼叫远端 A2A agent
  - `a2a_discover` / `a2a_send` / `a2a_task_status` / `a2a_cancel`
  - 地址白名单（`clientAllowPatterns`）控制 agent 可呼叫的目标
- **可视化运维面板**（Web client 半，v0.2.0）：Plugins → @zyfgood/dsh-a2a 的配置卡与设置 Plugins 分区的 A2A 标签页
  - 服务器状态：运行中/模式/地址/协议版本/鉴权 + curl 验证命令一键复制
  - 实时任务板：最近任务的状态徽标/上下文/产物数，非终态任务一键取消（5s 自动刷新）
  - 远端 agent 目录：保存常用远端地址，浏览器直连拉取其 Agent Card（名称/版本/技能）
  - 数据来自 A2A 服务器自带的 `/admin/status`、`/admin/tasks` 端点（Bearer 门禁同 JSON-RPC）

零运行时依赖（纯 Node ≥20 stdlib + 全局 fetch），与 [dsh-feishu-bot](https://github.com/zyfgood/dsh-feishu-bot) 同一插件体系。

## 一、安装

```bash
# 官方 CLI 一键安装（npm 渠道，推荐；bundle patch 自动挂载）
dsh plugin --profile <name> add @zyfgood/dsh-a2a

# 或 GitHub
dsh plugin --profile <name> add github:zyfgood/dsh-a2a

# 或本地路径
dsh plugin --profile <name> add file:D:/DSHProjects/dsh-a2a
```

> npm 裸名 `dsh-a2a` 是另一个无关项目（TtTRz/dsh-a2a），本插件发布在 `@zyfgood` scope 下，安装时请带 scope。

重启 profile 后生效。默认监听 `127.0.0.1:7310`。

> `lib/` 预构建产物随仓库发布，安装即用，无需构建脚本（无 pnpm ≥10 的 `allowBuilds` 步骤）。

## 二、快速验证

```bash
# 1) Agent Card（0.3 路径）
curl http://127.0.0.1:7310/.well-known/agent-card.json

# 2) 发一条消息（同步）
curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:7310/ -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "method": "message/send",
  "params": {
    "message": {
      "kind": "message",
      "role": "user",
      "parts": [{"kind": "text", "text": "你好，介绍一下你自己"}],
      "messageId": "m-1",
      "contextId": "ctx-demo"
    }
  }
}'
```

返回的 `result` 是 A2A Task：`status.state === "completed"`，回复文本在 `artifacts[0].parts[0].text`。同一 `contextId` 再次调用会复用同一个 DSH agent 会话（多轮记忆）。

流式：

```bash
curl -N -X POST http://127.0.0.1:7310/ \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "Accept: text/event-stream" -d '{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 2, "method": "message/stream",
  "params": {"message": {"kind": "message", "role": "user",
    "parts": [{"kind": "text", "text": "流式演示"}], "messageId": "m-2", "contextId": "ctx-demo"}}
}'
```

SSE 依次推送 `status-update(working)` → `artifact-update` → `status-update(completed, final=true)` 后自然收流。

## 三、配置项

profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`（或本包 `cordis.patch.yml` 默认层）：

```yaml
- id: a2a
  name: '@zyfgood/dsh-a2a'
  config:
    port: 7310
    mode: agent
```

| 配置 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `host` | `127.0.0.1` | 监听地址；公网暴露改 `0.0.0.0` 并配合鉴权 |
| `port` | `7310` | 监听端口（`0` = 系统分配） |
| `publicUrl` | 按监听地址推导 | 写入 Agent Card 的 `url`；反代/TLS 部署时必须配置为外部可达地址 |
| `bearerToken` | 无 | Bearer 鉴权令牌，支持 `env:VAR`；配置后卡片宣告 `bearerAuth` |
| `agentName` / `agentDescription` / `agentVersion` | `DSH Agent` / … | Agent Card 元信息 |
| `skills` | 内置一条 dsh-agent 技能 | Agent Card 技能清单 |
| `mode` | `agent` | 入站处理模式：`agent` / `llm` / `echo`（见下） |
| `provider` / `model` | — | 模型来源：`llm` 模式直答，`agent` 模式创建会话时写入；未配置时回退宿主默认模型（GUI 的默认模型，即 profile 的 `agent-default-model` 分节） |
| `systemPrompt` / `maxHistory` | — | `llm` 模式参数（`ctx.llm` 直答，短期记忆按 `maxHistory`） |
| `agentId` | 自动 | `agent` 模式：固定复用 `ctx.agents` 中某会话；不配置则按 contextId 自动创建 |
| `agentPreset` | GUI 默认预设 | 自动创建会话的 preset（决定 agent 可用的工具集） |
| `workspace` | `process.cwd()` | 自动创建会话的工作目录 |
| `persistSessions` | `true` | contextId → 会话映射落盘（`$DSH_HOME/a2a/`），重启后自动恢复上下文 |
| `turnTimeoutMs` | `600000` | 单轮执行上限，超时任务置 `failed` |
| `taskTtlMs` | `3600000` | 已完结任务内存保留时长（之后 TTL 回收） |
| `tools` | `true` | 是否注册 `a2a_*` 出站工具 |
| `clientAllowPatterns` | `['*']` | 出站白名单：`'*'`、`https://a2a.example.com/`、`https://*.example.com/`、`'*:7310'` |
| `clientTimeoutMs` | `120000` | 出站调用超时 |

### 三种入站模式

- **`agent`（默认）**：每个 A2A `contextId` 对应一个持久 DSH agent 会话（完整工具/技能/工作目录），跨任务续答；映射可落盘跨重启恢复。会话忙时新消息走 `steer`（下一 step 边界消费）。
- **`llm`**：`ctx.llm` 直答（自包含轻量模式，不建 agent 会话，短期记忆按 `maxHistory`）。
- **`echo`**：回显原文，验证链路。

## 四、出站：agent 调用远端 A2A

插件默认注册 4 个模型工具（`tools: false` 关闭）：

| 工具 | 对应协议方法 | 用途 |
|---|---|---|
| `a2a_discover` | `GET /.well-known/agent-card.json` | 拉取远端 Agent Card（能力/技能/鉴权） |
| `a2a_send` | `message/stream`（自动降级 `message/send` + 轮询） | 发消息并等待远端最终回复 |
| `a2a_task_status` | `tasks/get` | 查询远端任务状态 |
| `a2a_cancel` | `tasks/cancel` | 取消远端任务 |

对话示例：「用 a2a_send 呼叫 http://其它机器:7310/ 的 agent，问它有哪些技能，把结果汇总给我」。

## 五、开发

```bash
pnpm verify   # 本地 typecheck（shims/ 提供 @deepseek-ai 结构类型）
pnpm test     # 构建 DSH 无关核心 + 35 项端到端冒烟测试
pnpm build:local  # 本地全量构建 lib/（shims 类型校验，产物与宿主构建一致）
pnpm build    # 完整构建（需要宿主环境提供 @deepseek-ai/* peer 依赖）
```

代码结构：

```
src/
├── index.ts       插件入口：Config schema + apply()
├── protocol.ts    A2A 类型 / JSON-RPC / Agent Card（纯函数，零依赖）
├── store.ts       任务存储 + SSE 事件中枢（事件缓冲、订阅、TTL）
├── server.ts      HTTP 服务器：card / message/send / message/stream(SSE) / tasks/* / admin/*
├── bridge.ts      DSH 桥接：echo / llm / agent 三种 TaskRunner
├── client.ts      出站 A2A 客户端（fetch + SSE 解析）
├── tools.ts       a2a_* 模型工具注册
└── persistence.ts contextId → 会话映射落盘
client/
└── client.js      浏览器半：A2A 运维面板（免构建 ModuleLoader 工厂，react 为宿主 external）
```

设计说明：

- `protocol` / `store` / `server` / `client` 不依赖任何 DSH 包，可独立构建与测试；DSH 桥接收敛在 `bridge.ts` / `tools.ts` / `index.ts`。
- **agent 模式必须有模型**：agent-loop 不自动兜底 provider/model，缺失时提示词组装里的 `{{model}}` 无值，每轮立即报错（表现为「无文本输出」）。插件因此按「配置 provider/model → 回退 `ctx.agentDefaultModel.currentSelection()`」解析，两者都拿不到时直接返回明确的失败说明；本轮若以 `turn/end reason=error` 结束，错误原因会被回给客户端而不是笼统占位符。改 profile 的默认模型后，新建的 A2A 会话即生效（已存在的会话沿用原模型，删 `$DSH_HOME/a2a/context-sessions.json` 条目可重建）。
- 任务 id 参数：规范写法 `params.id` 与本插件旧约定 `params.taskId` 都接受（`tasks/get` / `tasks/cancel` / `tasks/resubscribe`）。
- `input-required` 事件带 `final=true` 关闭当轮 SSE，但任务保持非终态，客户端可凭 `taskId` 续答（续答复用同一任务与 history）。
- `tasks/cancel` 立即广播 `canceled(final=true)`；agent 模式下正在运行的一轮会在 500ms 轮询粒度感知退出并尽力 `interrupt`，不会阻塞后续轮次。
- 与 A2A 0.2.x 客户端的兼容：旧 card 路径照常服务；0.2 客户端不发送版本头时按同版本处理。
- 不支持的协议面按规范返回明确错误码：push notification `-32003`、批量 JSON-RPC `-32600`。

## 六、与 DSH 内置能力的关系

| 需求 | 用什么 |
|---|---|
| 程序化驱动 DSH agent（进程外） | 内置 ACP（`dsh-acp`，`pnpm dsh --profile acp`） |
| 挂载外部工具/资源 | 内置 MCP 客户端 |
| 跨 agent 生态互操作（Google ADK / A2A SDK） | **本插件** |

## License

MIT

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin for Sub2api account quotas and usage monitoring
plugins.readme_text:
# sub2api Account Usage Monitor

English | [中文](<docs/zh.md>)

`dsh-sub2api-monitor` is a DSH desktop plugin compatible with DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` and `0.2.1-rc.2`. It provides only a usage entry in the conversation title bar, with no sidebar entry, full page, or centered dialog. The title-bar popover has a maximum width of 700px and adapts to the viewport, balancing two-column cards with readability. Clicking outside, pressing Esc, or clicking Close dismisses it; clicking inside does not. It does not modify DSH core or start additional processes or HTTP services.

## Data and refresh

The Host reads the paginated account list, each account's `/usage`, and `/today-stats` through the management API. It refreshes every 60 seconds by default, processing at most 3 accounts concurrently. The Client reads the local cache every 10 seconds; manual refresh has a minimum interval of 10 seconds. All timers and requests are disposed of on plugin unload. Operations are read-only: the plugin does not call account start/stop, credential refresh, or quota-reset endpoints.

- Quota windows: 5-hour, 7-day, and upstream Sonnet/Opus windows, showing usage percentages and relative reset times, with full timestamps on hover. Anthropic explicitly uses `source=passive`, matching the site's passive sampling; the default active endpoint may omit weekly quotas.
- Compact, responsive cards retain today's statistics and abbreviate large numbers. The top explanation area and search box are removed; synchronization status appears as a title-bar dot.
- Subscription type: only allowlisted scalar values from `credentials.plan_type` are extracted, displayed separately from authentication methods such as OAuth. `promax` is shown as the site's corresponding `Pro 500`; missing values display “Unknown subscription”. The credentials object is never passed through.
- Today's requests, tokens, and cost use the Shanghai time zone. Costs use sub2api's accounting basis and are not equivalent to the provider's actual bill.
- Highlights at 80%/95%; the conversation summary counts accounts needing attention. System notifications are not currently sent.
- Unknown fields remain unknown. Partial failures are marked separately; list failures retain old data with a stale indicator. Upstream snapshots may predate collection; source timestamps are shown when supplied by the API.

## Account details

Click a card (or press Enter/Space) to open details within the same popover; Back returns to the list. Details load `/admin/accounts/:id/stats?days=30&timezone=Asia%2FShanghai` only on demand, cache for 60 seconds, and coalesce concurrent requests. Only known collected account IDs are accepted, redirects are rejected, and the Host projects allowlisted fields. No historical database or background history polling is added.

The view shows period totals, reported window length and recorded date range, daily request/Token/account-cost bars, model ranking by Token with expandable input/output/cache composition, active-day averages, peak days, and mean request duration. Missing dates are not filled with zeros. This covers only calls through sub2api; costs are not subscription bills, and mean duration is not time to first token. Account costs use `actual_cost` for daily records and `account_cost` for models; missing fields stay unknown. Errors offer retry; leaving details aborts the UI request, while shared Host work is bounded by timeout and unload cancellation.

## Installation and plugin configuration

Install the npm package `dsh-sub2api-monitor` in DSH's Plugins page. Open the configuration form in the plugin details, fill in the following fields, and save. Configuration is embedded directly in the plugin information page rather than registering a host settings page; the Configuration button at the top of the usage popover also opens it. DSH's settings service writes configuration to the profile; no plugin source edits are needed. The read endpoint returns only non-sensitive fields, the credential reference name, and whether a key is set. Leaving the key input blank preserves the existing value; the first save requires a key. Saves use revisions to detect concurrent conflicts and do not automatically overwrite changes from another window.

Disable the old `sub2api-monitor` and earlier `myspace-sub2api-monitor` packages before enabling the new package to avoid duplicate collection. After moving parameters into plugin configuration, uninstall the old package. Both the component ID and configuration namespace are `dsh-sub2api-monitor`; connection configuration is managed only by the DSH profile. When upgrading to 0.1.0, also replace the old component ID in the profile with the new ID while preserving its config fields; do not just swap packages and lose configuration.

- `baseUrl`: the site's API address, including `/api/v1`.
- `adminApiKeyEnv`: credential reference (environment-variable-style name) for the administrator API key; default `SUB2API_ADMIN_API_KEY`. The profile stores only this name. A key entered in the form is written to the DSH credentials service (`$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml` with the local provider), not to plugin configuration. The process environment or a `.env` file can also supply it; an inherited environment value is read-only and disables the key input.
- `allowInsecureHttp`: off by default; enable only after explicitly accepting plaintext risks.
- `intervalSeconds`: 30–3600 seconds; default 60 seconds.
- `primaryAccounts`: select multiple accounts from a checkbox list loaded automatically from the unfiltered Host cache. Refresh Accounts fetches upstream data using the saved connection (10-second cooldown). Missing selected accounts are retained; failures never clear selections. Internally stored as exact names, empty by default. Primary cards show a badge.
- `primaryFirst`: defaults to true; places primary accounts before the selected secondary ordering.
- `displayFilter`: `all`, `primary`, `available`, or `attention`. Attention includes unavailable accounts, failed usage/statistics requests, and usage at or above 80%.
- `sortBy`: `available` (default), `name`, `usage-desc`, or `usage-asc`. Usage sorting compares the highest known usage percentage across windows; unknown values sort last. Filtering does not change upstream collection. Settings persist in the profile and are applied to subsequent cache reads. The title-bar count reflects the filtered set; the web dashboard remains independent.

Only the Host resolves the key, once per request, so rotation takes effect on the next refresh without a restart. It is never injected into the Client module, usage endpoint, or profile. The credentials file is plaintext with owner-only permissions; it is not disk encryption.

```json
{
  "baseUrl": "https://your-sub2api.example/api/v1",
  "adminApiKeyEnv": "SUB2API_ADMIN_API_KEY",
  "allowInsecureHttp": false,
  "intervalSeconds": 60
}
```

Set `allowInsecureHttp` to `true` only after explicitly accepting plaintext transport risks. To rotate the key, enter a new one in the form, or update the credential through the DSH credentials service; no reinstallation is needed.

Upgrading from 0.1.x: the plaintext `adminApiKey` field has been removed. Move its value into the credentials service under `SUB2API_ADMIN_API_KEY` (or re-enter it in the form), then delete `adminApiKey` from the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`.

The old standalone JSON configuration and `SUB2API_MONITOR_CONFIG` environment variable are no longer read. Delete the old configuration file after migration, keeping plugin configuration as the single authority.

Upstream redirects are rejected to prevent key leakage. The frontend receives only allowlisted display fields, excluding credentials, extra, notes, and raw errors.

The local `/sub2api-monitor/api` accepts only loopback requests, a valid local Host, a same-origin Origin when present, and the custom header `X-Sub2api-Monitor: 1`. CORS is not enabled. Remote browsers and cross-machine connections are not currently supported.

## Installation and verification

The only dependency is the official `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` configuration schema package; there is no generation step

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-sidechat

[English](README_EN.md) · 中文

DSH 侧边聊天插件：从主会话 fork 独立侧聊，划选引用并添加注释，将结论回流到主会话。

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:kkisok0123/dsh-sidechat
```

本仓库包含源码和预编译的 `lib/`，GitHub 安装无需在用户机器上编译。安装后重启 `dsh web` 并刷新窗口。

如果已经安装 `dsh-sidenote`，请先移除旧插件，再安装本插件，避免重复入口：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-sidenote
```

进入已有回复的会话，点击顶栏「侧边」，或在输入框使用 `/side`，打开右侧栏中的插件面板。

## 功能

- 独立侧聊继承主会话完整历史，主线与侧聊分别运行。
- 侧聊语义与 Codex `/side` 对齐：首条消息注入边界协议块（继承历史仅作参照、侧聊是独立助手：默认非改写、不碰子代理、不主动请求越权），面板以「侧边会话边界」卡呈现。
- DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 上复用宿主原生 Conversation Factory，包括消息、工具、模型、权限及输入框；旧宿主使用插件自绘面板。
- 模型菜单刷新并显示提供方，切换模型后恢复输入焦点。
- 划选 assistant 正文：「添加到对话」保留可选注解编辑器；「在侧边聊天中提问」直接打开/聚焦侧聊、加入选中文字引用并聚焦输入框，不弹注解框、不覆盖草稿、不自动发送。打开失败时保留选中文字，可重试或取消。
- 临时侧聊在当前浏览器的会话列表中隐藏，可重开；保存为正式会话时创建可见副本。
- 侧聊结论可作为引用回流到主会话。

下面是右侧栏布局示例。实际消息与输入框样式随宿主版本、主题和原生渲染模式变化；它不是宿主自带的浮动侧边对话窗口。

![右侧栏布局示例](docs/assets/04-side-chat-panel.png)

## 兼容性

当前包保留原插件的引擎声明，使用 Node.js 20 及以上。原生会话渲染针对 DSH **0.2.0-rc.2** 实现；引擎范围不代表所有组合都已验证。

## 开发

```bash
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm check:arch
pnpm typecheck
pnpm build
pnpm check:package
```

修改源码后，将对应 `lib/` 一并提交。CI 重建并检查构建产物与已提交版本一致，以保持 GitHub 直接安装可用。

## 来源与许可

本插件基于 [gyixuan 的 dsh-sidenote](https://github.com/g-yixuan/dsh-sidenote) 改进。感谢原作者提供侧边聊天、划选注释及回流能力的基础实现。本项目不是从零原创，也不是上游官方发行版。

本分支主要改进了宿主原生会话渲染、侧聊边界协议、划选后直接在侧聊提问、模型切换与输入焦点恢复，以及 DSH 0.2.1-alpha.4 兼容性。具体功能和限制见上文。

保留原作者 `Copyright (c) 2026 gyixuan` 与完整 [MIT 许可](LICENSE)。本仓库从独立源码快照建立，未继承原 Git 提交历史；后续改进由本仓库维护者负责。

# Hackathon -- Plug-In

本仓库是 **DSH 黑客松的插件方向**工作区（远程仓库
[kirahvi03/Hackathon--Plug-In](https://github.com/kirahvi03/Hackathon--Plug-In)）。
内容分两部分：

1. **本机开发环境**的配置与自检脚本（第 1–3 节）
2. **DSH 插件**：骨架 `plugins/hackathon-starter/` 与参赛作品
   `plugins/dsh-intent-translator/`（第 4 节）

游戏方向的仓库在另一处：[Hackathon--Game](https://github.com/kirahvi03/Hackathon--Game)
（本地路径 `..\hackathon-game`）。

插件体系的完整研究报告见 [`docs/dsh-plugin-development-report.md`](docs/dsh-plugin-development-report.md)
（58KB，含官方 API 导出名、slot key 目录、模板出处与未能确定事项清单）。

---

## 1. 环境总览

| 组件 | 版本 | 位置 / 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Node.js | v24.21.0 | `C:\Program Files\nodejs\node.exe`（系统安装，已在 PATH 中） |
| npm | 11.19.0 | 随 Node 提供 |
| pnpm | 11.7.0 | 由 `~\.dsh\bin\pnpm.cmd` 转发到 DSH 内置 pnpm 11.7.0 |
| Python | 3.12.14 | DSH 内置解释器，已通过 PATH 前置覆盖失效的商店别名 |
| pip | 26.2.1 | `~\.dsh\bin\pip.cmd` → `python -m pip` |
| Git | 2.55.0 | `C:\Program Files\Git\cmd\git.exe` |
| GitHub 凭据 | 已就绪 | Git Credential Manager 2.9.1，账号 `kirahvi03` |
| VS Code | 1.140.0 | 命令行入口 `code` 可用 |
| ffmpeg | 7.1.1 | 已在 PATH 中 |

未安装（按需再补）：`gh`（GitHub CLI）、`docker`、PowerShell 7（`pwsh`）。

Python 预装库：`numpy` 2.3.5、`pandas` 3.0.1、`openpyxl` 3.1.5、`XlsxWriter` 3.2.9、
`python-docx` 1.2.0、`python-pptx` 1.0.2、`Pillow` 12.3.0、`lxml` 6.1.3。

---

## 2. 本次为环境做的改动

1. **修复 Python**：PATH 上原本只有 Microsoft Store 的 `python.exe` 占位符（执行即失败）。
   现已把可用的 DSH 内置解释器目录前置到用户 PATH。
2. **补上 pnpm**：`pnpm` 之前不在 PATH 上。新增 `~\.dsh\bin\pnpm.cmd`、`pnpx.cmd` shim，
   指向 DSH 内置 pnpm，并把 `~\.dsh\bin` 加到用户 PATH 最前面。
3. **补上 pip 入口**：内置 Python 的 `Scripts` 目录没有可执行文件，新增 `pip.cmd` shim。
4. **PowerShell 执行策略**：当前用户范围设为 `RemoteSigned`，本地脚本可直接运行。
5. **初始化本仓库**：`main` 分支、`.gitignore`、`.gitattributes`。
6. **GitHub 凭据**：全局 `credential.helper = manager`，`git push` 无需再次登录。

> 以上 PATH 改动写入的是**用户级**环境变量。已打开的终端需要重开一次才能生效。

---

## 3. 快速开始

### 3.1 环境自检

```powershell
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\env-check.ps1
```

全部通过时退出码为 0，并逐项打印各工具的实际版本与路径。缺少可选项（`gh`/`docker`）只告警。

### 3.2 Web / Node 项目

```powershell
pnpm init                 # 或 pnpm create vite my-app
pnpm add -D typescript    # 依赖安装
pnpm dev                  # 跑开发服务器
```

> 用 `npm` 也可以，但本工作区统一用 `pnpm` 以节省磁盘并避免依赖提升问题。

### 3.3 Python 项目

全局解释器可直接用；做正式项目建议建虚拟环境，避免污染内置环境：

```powershell
python -m venv .venv
.\.venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1
pip install -r requirements.txt
```

> 若激活脚本被执行策略拦截，先运行
> `Set-ExecutionPolicy -Scope Process -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Force`。

### 3.4 推送到 GitHub

远程仓库已接好并完成首次推送：

| 项 | 值 |
| --- | --- |
| 仓库 | <https://github.com/kirahvi03/Hackathon--Plug-In>（public） |
| remote | `origin` |
| 分支 | `main`，已设置上游跟踪 `origin/main` |

日常提交：

```powershell
git add -A
git commit -m "feat: ..."
git push
```

认证由 Git Credential Manager 自动完成（本机已存 `kirahvi03` 的 token，含 `repo` + `workflow` 权限），
正常情况不会再弹出登录。

---

## 4. DSH 插件：骨架与参赛作品

### 4.1 插件骨架（`plugins/hackathon-starter/`）

本机 DSH 是 **0.2.1-rc.2**，插件框架为 **Cordis 4**。一个插件包 = 一个 bundle，
由 `package.json` 的 `dsh.bundle.patch` 指向 `cordis.patch.yml`，后者把插件行 insert 进 profile 的插件树。

骨架同时演示两个扩展点：

| 半边 | 文件 | 内容 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Host | `index.js` | 具名导出 `{ Config, apply, inject, name }`，用 `ctx.tools.register(defineTool({...}))` 注册工具 `plugin_ping` |
| Client | `client.js` | `window.__ModuleLoader__.load` + `ctx.slots.register` 往 `conversation.composer.dock` 插一个徽标 |

每个 API 字段都对照官方实现 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-todo` 抄写（不是猜测）：
`name` / `description` / `parameters` / `output.{schema,render}` / `execute(args, exec)` / `presentCall(args)`。

**语法自检**（无需安装任何依赖）：

```powershell
node --check .\plugins\hackathon-starter\index.js
node --check .\plugins\hackathon-starter\client.js
```

**安装到 profile**（转发给内置 pnpm，必须用绝对路径）：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "C:\Users\19371\Documents\deepseek-harness\default-workspace\plugins\hackathon-starter"
```

> ⚠️ 尚未替你执行安装：`desktop` 是当前运行中的这个应用独占管理的 profile，
> 安装后需重启才生效，可能打断正在进行的会话。要装的话说一声。

> ℹ️ 官方包（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` 等）**不在 npm 上**，它们打包在 `app.asar` 内。
> 插件通过 `peerDependencies` 声明版本要求，由宿主提供实现，因此**不要自己 `pnpm add` 这些包**。

### 4.2 参赛作品：`plugins/dsh-intent-translator/`

面向 vibecoding 的**意图翻译器**：用亮蓝色 `#66ccff` 标出输入里的 1–3 处模糊描述，
每一处独立分叉成 2–3 个「人话方向」卡片；点选一张只替换它所属的模糊片段，
「背景有图片」这类确定信息原样保留。支持撤回和「换一组」。

![意图翻译器多片段候选卡片](plugins/dsh-intent-translator/docs/preview.png)

| 项 | 位置 / 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| 工具行按钮 | `conversation.input.left`，与 `dsh-prompt-optimizer` 的 ✨ 同槽位 |
| 候选卡片 | `conversation.input.dock`，输入框上方 |
| Host | `lib/host.js`：`ctx.webServer` 路由 + `ctx.llm.stream()`，15s 超时 |
| 纯逻辑 | `lib/engine.js`：多片段校验、人话标签守卫、方向去重、span 定位与替换 |
| Client | `client.src.js` → `client.js`：按钮、卡片、`#66ccff` 高亮、逐段替换、撤回、换一组 |
| 完整说明 | [`plugins/dsh-intent-translator/README.md`](plugins/dsh-intent-translator/README.md) |
| 实现计划 | [`docs/dsh-intent-translator-plan.md`](docs/dsh-intent-translator-plan.md) |

安装到 `desktop` profile（需要重启一次让 Host 新行生效）：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "C:\path\to\Hackathon--Plug-In\plugins\dsh-intent-translator"
```

验证：

```powershell
cd plugins\dsh-intent-translator
npm test        # 构建 client.js，再跑 34 个 Node 测试
```

V2 只预留接口：点选方向后可通过 `ctx` 调用 `dsh-prompt-optimizer` 精修，
V1 不自动调用，也不复制其代码。详见插件 README。

---

## 5. 注意事项

- **不要在 DSH 会话里直接 `.\script.ps1`**：DSH 托管的 shell 对脚本加载有额外限制，
  会报 “未对文件进行数字签名”。加上 `-ExecutionPolicy Bypass` 用子进程运行即可：
  `powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\env-check.ps1`。
  你自己开的普通终端不受此限制。
- **不要 `pip install` 到内置 Python 之外**：`python` 已指向 DSH 内置解释器，
  装包会写进 DSH 的 `site-packages`。长期项目用 `.venv` 隔离。
- **密钥不入库**：`.gitignore` 已覆盖 `.env`、`*.pem`、`credentials.json` 等；
  需要提交样例时用 `.env.example`。
- **行尾符**：`.gitattributes` 统一仓库内为 LF，Windows 下工作区仍可用 CRLF。

---

## 6. 目录结构

```
.
├─ README.md                              本文件
├─ .gitignore                             忽略规则（Node / Python / 密钥 / 编辑器）
├─ .gitattributes                         行尾符与二进制文件规则
├─ docs/
│  ├─ dsh-plugin-development-report.md    DSH 插件开发研究报告（58KB）
│  └─ dsh-intent-translator-plan.md       意图翻译器实现计划
├─ plugins/
│  ├─ hackathon-starter/                  ← 插件骨架
│  │  ├─ package.json                     bundle 清单（dsh.bundle.patch / dsh.client）
│  │  ├─ cordis.patch.yml                 把插件行 insert 进 profile
│  │  ├─ index.js                         Host 半边：注册 plugin_ping 工具
│  │  ├─ client.js                        Client 半边：输入框下方徽标
│  │  ├─ icon.svg                         插件卡片图标
│  │  ├─ locale/{zh,en}.json              显示名称与描述
│  │  └─ README.md                        骨架的改造指引
│  └─ dsh-intent-translator/              ← 参赛作品：意图翻译器
│     ├─ package.json                     bundle + dsh.client + peerDependencies
│     ├─ cordis.patch.yml                 Host 行 insert
│     ├─ index.js                         Host 入口
│     ├─ lib/{engine,host}.js             纯逻辑 + 路由/LLM/超时
│     ├─ client.src.js → client.js        Client 源码与构建产物
│     ├─ scripts/build-client.mjs         零依赖构建（内联 engine.js）
│     ├─ test/*.test.mjs                  34 个 Node 测试
│     ├─ docs/preview.png                 验收截图（居中悬浮面板）
│     └─ README.md                        安装/配置/数据契约/V2 边界
└─ scripts/
   └─ env-check.ps1                       环境自检脚本
```

plugins.readme_text: # @deepwhale-cn/dsh-agent-scope [![dshfind 收录](https://dshfind.com/api/badge/feely0208/dsh-agent-scope?lang=zh)](https://dshfind.com/zh/plugins/feely0208/dsh-agent-scope) **Agent 权限边界** —— 查 agent 的工具/文件/网络权限有没有声明、是不是过宽。 ## 不装它会怎样 你的 MCP 配置长这样： ```json "filesystem": { "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem", "/"] }, "everything": { "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "mcp-everything"], "allowedTools": ["*"] } ``` **看起来是「配置齐全」，实际上：** ``` ① 文件访问路径是 / → agent 能读写你所有文件（含 ~/.ssh、~/.aws） ② allowedTools: ["*"] → agent 能调用所有工具（读文件、执行命令、发请求） ③ allowedDomains: "*" → 被注入后能把数据发到任意地址 ``` **Agent 的权限就是它的爆炸半径。** 一旦被提示注入控制， 它能做的事 = **你给它的全部权限**。 OWASP 把这归为 **LLM06 Excessive Agency**。 ## 关键词 **关键词**：Agent 权限 · 工具权限 · 权限边界 · 最小权限 · MCP 权限 · 沙箱 · 白名单 · 爆炸半径 **Keywords**: agent scope · tool permissions · least privilege · MCP security · excessive agency · sandbox ## 它查什么 | 级别 | 内容 | 依据 | |---|---|---| | 🔴 高 | 工具权限用通配符 `*` | 最小权限（NIST SP 800-53 AC-6）| | 🔴 高 | 文件访问是 `/` / `~` / 整个用户目录 | MCP 文档 · 目录限制建议 | | 🟡 中 | 网络访问无限制 | OWASP **LLM06 Excessive Agency** | | 🟡 中 | 配置里**找不到任何权限声明** | 最小权限 · 权限应显式声明 | ## 「没有声明」为什么危险 **没有声明通常等于默认全开** —— 而用户看到的只是一个「很干净」的配置文件， 不会意识到 agent 能做所有事。 ## 安装 ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add @deepwhale-cn/dsh-agent-scope # 或纯 CLI npx @deepwhale-cn/dsh-agent-scope ``` ![dsh-agent-scope 检查报告示例](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-agent-scope/report.png) ![dsh-agent-scope 演示模式输出](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-agent-scope/demo.png) ![dsh-agent-scope 规则与依据](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-agent-scope/rules.png) ## 用法 ```bash dsh-agent-scope --demo dsh-agent-scope --list-rules dsh-agent-scope --html r.html ``` ## 边界 - **只审配置，不审 agent 实现** —— agent 代码里怎么用这些权限，本工具看不到。 - **不判断「给得够不够」** —— 只查「有没有声明、有没有明显过宽」。 权限偏大但没用通配符的情况需要人工评审。 - **配置位置各客户端不同** —— 按常见路径找（mcp.json / .mcp.json / settings.json / claude_desktop_config.json）。 - **沙箱是否真生效** 需要运行时验证，不在范围内。 - 与 [dsh-mcp-audit](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-mcp-audit) 分工： 那个查 MCP **服务来源**（未锁版本/明文端点），这个查 MCP **权限边界**。 - 与 [dsh-least-privilege](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-least-privilege) 分工： 那个查**容器/云/Web** 权限，这个查 **agent** 权限。 本插件是一个工具。使用者必须遵守所在地区法律法规，**对使用本项目造成的任何后果自行承担责任。** --- ## 深鲸网安守护系列（共 38 个） > plugins.description: Discover and verify DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugins from GitHub topic:dsh-plugin — trust score, official peer compatibility, one-click install via the official installer
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH Plugin Scout

[English](README.md) | [中文](docs/zh.md)

[![ci](https://github.com/fegnze/dsh-plugin-scout/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/fegnze/dsh-plugin-scout/actions/workflows/ci.yml) · MIT

Discover and verify DeepSeek Harness plugins published under the GitHub topic `dsh-plugin`, from inside DSH. Plugins are grouped by purpose, ranked by trust score, and checked against the official peer-compatibility rule. Supports DSH **0.2.x** (`>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0`); tested on desktop 0.2.0-rc.2.

> The in-app UI is currently Chinese only. The plugin's title and description in the official Plugins page are localized (`locale/en.json`, `locale/zh.json`).

## Install

Open the official **Plugins** page → **Add plugin**, and enter one of:

| Spec | Notes |
| --- | --- |
| `dsh-plugin-scout` | Recommended. Prebuilt npm package with provenance; no install scripts, no build approval needed |
| Absolute path of a prebuilt `dsh-plugin-scout-<version>.tgz`, if supplied with a release | Bypasses the npm registry; the current tag workflow creates release notes only and does not attach a tarball |

From the CLI: `dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-plugin-scout`. Enable it on the Plugins page, then open **Plugins → Scout**. The tab is labeled **Scout** in both languages; no sidebar entry is added. The official **Discover** tab is unchanged.

Do not install from `github:fegnze/dsh-plugin-scout`: a git install fetches source without `lib/`, and this repository deliberately ships no `prepare` script.

## Native Discover index

Add this URL in the official **Plugins → Discover → Index sources** dialog:

```text
https://fegnze.github.io/dsh-plugin-scout/index.json
```

This is a format-1 catalog, not an embedded Scout page. You do not need to install Scout to browse it. GitHub Actions rebuilds it daily at 03:23 UTC and on generator changes, then deploys only after the official DSH validator accepts the document. Failed generation leaves the previous deployment intact.

The public catalog contains deduplicated npm bundles compatible with the target DSH 0.2.1-rc.2, with a matching repository, no install hooks, and advertised provenance. Archived, risky, version-drifted, stale or incomplete entries are excluded. Forks retain a source label. Provenance presence is not cryptographic verification or a security guarantee. Each entry pins the npm version and uses npm's real release time; the official installer remains the final authority. The target runtime is a publishing policy, not a compatibility claim for every DSH release.

Generate from public GitHub/npm data with `GH_TOKEN=<read-only-token> node scripts/generate-market.mjs`. `MARKET_OUTPUT`, `SCOUT_CACHE`, and `DSH_TARGET` override the output, disposable crawl cache, and target runtime. No local profile or user cache is published. The generated `site/index.json` and crawl cache are ignored by Git; CI uploads only the public catalog as the Pages artifact. Adding the source remains your explicit action; Scout does not alter configured index sources.

## One-click install, through the official installer

The **Install** button in the details drawer takes the same path as the official **Add plugin**: `inspect` first, then `installBundle(spec, {enabled: false, requestId, registry})`. Installed plugins start **disabled**; **Enable** is a separate click (`setBundleEnabled`).

- Plugins with install hooks, or whose DSH peers do not cover the running version, need a second click to install.
- When the official installer blocks dependency build scripts (`pendingBuilds`), they are listed by name; a double click on **Allow and reinstall** retries with `approvedBuilds`.
- **Cancel install** calls `cancelInstall` with the same `requestId`; a lost reply is recovered with `waitForInstall`. On failure the official installer restores `package.json` and the lockfile.
- **Uninstalling and version exemptions stay on the official Plugins page.** Scout never calls `removeBundle`; the tests fail if it does. Without the official `pluginManager`, the Install button is hidden and the drawer falls back to "copy pinned spec + open the Plugins page".

## Data sources (first-party only)

| Source | Used for |
| --- | --- |
| GitHub GraphQL `search(topic:dsh-plugin)` | Repository metadata, root `package.json`, `cordis.patch.yml` text (never evaluated) |
| `registry.npmjs.org/<name>/latest` | The manifest that would actually be installed: peers, install hooks, `repository`, provenance |
| Official `pluginManager.listBundles` / `inspect` | Installed state; the official pre-install check (resolves only, runs no code) |
| Official `pluginManager.installBundle` / `waitForInstall` / `cancelInstall` / `setBundleEnabled` | One-click install (disabled by default), cancel, separate enable; progress from `plugin-manager/install-state` and `install-log` events |

No third-party marketplace or aggregator is used. Topic searches explicitly use `fork:true` to include both original repositories and forks; forks retain their source notice and undergo the same checks. After upgrading from 0.1.5 or earlier, use **Rebuild full index** once to discover older forks omitted by the previous search scope.

**Crawling, measured (2026-10):** the topic holds about 19,000 repositories, 12,700 of them created in August, many of them same-name copies. GitHub search returns at most 1,000 results per query, so Scout bisects time windows adaptively (≤900 results per window, 60 s minimum window). Pages are 50 items: 100-item pages return 502 in dense windows, so on 502 the page size steps down to 25, then 10, resuming from the same cursor. Later runs crawl incrementally by `pushed`.

**Refresh is streaming and pays only for what changed:**
- **Newest first.** Windows are seeded geometrically (last 6 h / 1 d / 3 d / 1 w / 1 mo / 3 mo / older) and paged from the newest. Window counting and paging overlap (3 workers).
- **Publish while crawling.** Each page is merged into the record set immediately and published every 1.5 s; the UI reloads the list when `status.rev` changes. The previous index stays usable throughout. A checkpoint is written every 30 s.
- **Pay for change.** With an existing index, a light query fetches metadata only (100 per page, no blobs). Repositories whose `pushedAt` is unchanged keep their facts and only refresh stars and similar metadata; changed ones fetch `package.json` and the patch by node id in batches of 50.
- **npm in parallel.** npm lookups run alongside the GitHub crawl (8 workers), only for repositories with new pushes, missing entries, or entries older than one day. Entries older than one day are refreshed oldest first, at most 800 per run, even when the repository was not seen in that incremental crawl.
- **Canonical source recovery.** A refresh also follows same-name npm packages' GitHub `repository` links with bounded, exact read-only queries. A source is added only when GitHub's actual root manifest declares the same package name; missing topics never justify treating an unrelated namesake as the publisher. Failed lookups do not fabricate source facts.
- **Activation does not wait for the index.** The ~30 MB index loads in the background; the UI first sees `loaded: false` and polls.

Measured on 2026-10-14 over a real network:

| Scenario | First results | Total | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Incremental, 1,082 repos pushed | 4.5 s | 38 s | 125 refetched blobs, 963 metadata-only, 70 npm lookups |
| Cold full crawl | 6.7 s | — | ~1,000 plugins browsable within 60 s; the rest fill in the background |

## Checks and trust score

| Check | Rule | Points |
| --- | --- | --- |
| V1 | Root `package.json` declares `dsh.bundle` / `dsh.client` (otherwise not a plugin) | 20 |
| V2 | Official peer rule: only `@deepseek-ai/dsh` and `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*`, `semver.satisfies(runtime, range, {includePrerelease})`, `workspace:*` means the running version. Inside the App, Scout calls `dsh-app-boot.evaluatePluginCompatibility` directly | covered 30 · no peers 10 · not covered 5 |
| V3 | Install hooks: preinstall / install / postinstall / prepare | none +15 · present −15 |
| V4 | Source chain: the same-name npm package's `repositor

plugins.description: Telegram out-of-band login approval and task-completion notifications for DeepSeek Harness (DSH)
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-telegram-login-approval

给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) 的 Web 访问加两层 Telegram 能力：

1. **登录带外批准** —— 有人尝试登录你的 DSH，必须你在手机上点确认，才发放会话 cookie。
2. **任务完成通知** —— 长任务跑完（或多轮任务结束）推一条消息到手机。

**DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 已原生支持 WebUI 远程持久设置**，建议设置 `remoteSettings: false`，
保留上游实现；关闭的是旧适配，不会关闭新版原生设置能力。
旧 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 仍可用默认开启的适配，为配置的公开 HTTPS origin 恢复 settings 整页 Host 持久配置。
两种方式都在原生模型页编辑模型、提供商、API Key 和默认模型，不增加独立网页或 TG 模型编辑，
不改变登录批准、会话及 Host/Origin 保护。详见 [远程原生设置](docs/remote-settings.md)。

零 npm 依赖（只用 Node 内置能力），以 Cordis 插件形式挂载，**不改 DSH 源码**。

---

## 为什么需要它

DSH 的 Web 登录是「每进程随机 token → 换取**30 天**签名 cookie」。设计本身很强
（HMAC 签名、绑定 authority、`SameSite=Strict`、不信任转发头），但有两个缺口：

| 缺口 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| token 泄露即接管 | 拿到正确 token 可直接换到 30 天会话，中间**没有任何人工确认环节** |
| 没有 logout | 官方文档明确：撤销只能「删凭据记录 + 重启 `dsh`」 |

本插件补上这两个缺口：**旧 launch token 不能直接登录；必须输入独立密钥并经 Telegram 批准。**
同时增加持久化、可撤销的独立浏览器会话。升级后旧浏览器须重新登录一次，不保留仅有旧 DSH Cookie 的兼容路径。

## 工作原理

不接管 `/` 的静态提供，而是包装共享 `ctx.connection.authorizeIndex`、`admit` 和 `requestRejection`，
在 DSH 原生签名 Cookie 之外叠加独立持久化会话，并在 WebServer upgrade 分发前检查。
index.html 的提供、目录遍历防护、`<base>` 注入及原 Host/Origin fence 全部保持 DSH 原样。

**升级须保留本地 `src/index.ts` 的 admit 双入口补丁**：0.2.0-rc.2 是 `admit → requestRejection`，
0.2.1-rc.2 是 `requestRejection → admit`，新版 HTTP RPC 直接走 admit。
只保留旧 requestRejection 包装会让原生有效 Cookie 绕过额外会话层；不要用未含此补丁的旧 Git HEAD 覆盖工作树。
本插件不是全局 HTTP 路由中间件：任意第三方 `webServer.register()` 路由若不调用 Connection，不会自动受保护。

登录入口不再依赖 URL 里的 token，而是要求一个**长期独立 Secret Key**：

```
GET /                       → 未认证，返回登录表单（不落 DSH 的 401）
POST /login  (secret)       → 校验 Secret Key
                              ├─ 错误                → 401；错误桶冷却中为 429，不发通知
                              ├─ 已有待批准/已批准    → 303 复用同一请求（不轰炸通知）
                              ├─ 正确但通知配额耗尽  → 429
                              └─ 正确               → 新建批准请求
                                                        ├─ 下发 nonce cookie
                                                        ├─ 发 Telegram 确认卡片
                                                        └─ 303 → /login/status?request=...
GET /login/status?request=… → 校验 nonce cookie 与请求绑定
                              ├─ pending             → 200 等待页（meta refresh 自动刷新）
                              ├─ denied / expired    → 403 / 410
                              └─ approved            → 单次消费，交回 DSH 完成 303 + Set-Cookie
```

**关键安全性质**：批准只是「准入」，不是「认证」。批准后仍由 DSH 原方法签发会话 cookie，
且批准**单次消费**、绑定浏览器 nonce——重放等待页只会得到 401。
还会签发独立 `__Host-dsh-web-session` Cookie；服务端只存随机凭证哈希和会话元数据。
任意多个浏览器可分别获批，不互相顶掉；过期/撤销实际拦截首页、API 与新 WS，并关闭该会话已有 WS。

### 旧 launch token 已停用

早期版本（M1）用 URL 里的 `?token=...` 作为门禁信号。该模型已**移除**：
带 `token` 查询参数的请求现在被明确拒绝（401），不再进入批准流程。
规格文档见 [`docs/dsh-telegram-login-approval.md`](docs/dsh-telegram-login-approval.md)（M1 历史设计）。

## 安装

### 1. 准备 Telegram Bot

- 找 [@BotFather](https://t.me/BotFather) 发 `/newbot`，拿到 token
- 找 [@userinfobot](https://t.me/userinfobot) 查你的**数字用户 ID**

> 建议**与其它 TG 插件使用不同的 Bot**。Telegram 的 `getUpdates` 一个 Bot 只能有一个消费者，
> 共用 Bot 会导致两个插件互相抢更新。

### 2. 生成 Secret Key

登录不再是「拿到 URL 就能进」，而是要输入一个独立密钥：

```bash
install -d -m 700 /etc/dsh
install -m 600 /dev/null /etc/dsh/web-secret.key
node -e "process.stdout.write(require('node:crypto').randomBytes(32).toString('base64url'))" > /etc/dsh/web-secret.key
```

文件必须是 **root 所有、权限 600 的普通文件**（32 字节随机数据编码为无填充 base64url，正好 43 字符；与管理台重置密钥一致）。
插件启动时会强制校验，不满足直接抛错——不会静默放行。

在管理员 Telegram 私聊发送 `/key` 可取回密钥；发送 `/web` 或 `/start` 打开 **🌐 Web 管理台**。
管理台展示实际绑定、内部/公开地址、密钥、Web 会话数、待批准数和各期限；支持交互设置、会话列表与踢出。
重置密钥、逐个/全部踢出均二次确认。完整说明见 [Web 管理台与启动衔接](docs/web-console.md)。

### 3. 放置插件

```bash
git clone https://github.com/JJDonald/dsh-telegram-login-approval.git
```

### 4. 配置 overlay

复制 `cordis.example.yml`，把 `<PLUGIN_DIR>` 换成插件在本机的**绝对路径**：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: telegram-login-approval
      name: '/home/you/dsh-telegram-login-approval/src/index.ts'   # Windows: 'F:/path/...'
      config:
        botTokenRef: TELEGRAM_LOGIN_BOT_TOKEN
        adminChatId: 123456789                        # 改成你自己的数字 ID
        publicOrigin: 'https://dsh.example.com'       # 你的公开 HTTPS origin
        botUsername: 'example_bot'                    # 你的 Bot 用户名（不含 @）
        secretFile: '/etc/dsh/web-secret.key'         # 上一步生成的文件
        dryRun: false
```

### 5. 启动

```bash
export TELEGRAM_LOGIN_BOT_TOKEN='123456:ABC...'

cd /path/to/deepseek-harness
node --import tsx/esm apps/cli/src/bin.ts \
  --profile web \
  --patch /path/to/cordis.yml \
  --no-open --port 8188
```

> `--patch` 属于 `dsh` 层级参数，必须放在 `--profile` **之后**、app 参数（`--no-open` 等）**之前**。

**要让管理台保存的绑定地址/端口生效**，后续部署必须采用 [`scripts/serve.ts`](scripts/serve.ts)
启动衔接（配置 [`scripts/serve.example.json`](scripts/serve.example.json)），或人工将保存值写入实际启动参数。
脚本从 `web-settings.json` 加载绑定与公开地址，传入 `--host/--port/--trusted-host`；
保留 READY/UNLOADED fail-closed 衔接并截获含 launch token 的上游 URL 输出。
详见 [部署步骤](docs/web-console.md#启动衔接后续人工部署)。**面板不会自动重启或修改 nginx/DNS。**

### 6. 首次登录

直接访问 `https://<你的 publicOrigin>/`，输入 Secret Key。
浏览器显示「等待 Telegram 确认」，同时 Telegram 收到带 **✅ 确认登录 / ❌ 拒绝** 按钮的卡片。
点确认后页面自动跳转进入。

## 配置项

| 键 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | `false` 时完全不包装（等价于未安装） |
| `remoteSettings` | `true` | 仅适配旧 0.2.0-rc.2 的 settings 客户端；新版 0.2.1-rc.2 建议设 `false`，保留原生远程设置 |
| `publicOrigin` | **必填** | 本部署唯一的公开 HTTPS origin，如 `https://dsh.example.com` |
| `botUsername` | `''` | Bot 用户名（不含 `@`）；仅用于页面文案与 `/key@<bot>` 匹配 |
| `secretFile` | **必填** | root-only Secret Key 文件的绝对路径 |
| `botTokenRef` | — | Bot Token 的**环境变量名**（推荐） |
| `botToken` | — | 直接写 token（不推荐，容易误提交） |
| `adminChatId` | **必填** | 唯一被接受的 Telegram 数字用户 ID |
| `ttlSeconds` | `300` | 新批准有效期，30–3600 整数秒；nonce Cookie 同步使用该期限 |
| `sessionDays` | `30` | 新Web会话有效期，整数天；不得超过当前DSH原生 `cookieMaxAgeDays` |
| `failureCooldownSeconds` | `600` | 全局10次错误密钥/60秒后仅限制错误输入，60–86400整数秒；正确密钥不受此冷却影响 |
| `windowSeconds` | `600` | Telegram确认通知触发限流窗口（与错误密钥冷却独立） |
| `maxTriggersPerWindow` | `3` | 窗口内最多触发次数 |
| `cooldownSeconds` | `600` | 通知触发超限后的冷却时长（不控制错误密钥冷却） |
| `notifyOnDeny` | `true` | 是否回发拒绝提示 |
| `dryRun` | `false` | `true` = 不碰网络，仅本地验证门禁行为 |
| `dataDir` | `$DSH_HOME/storages/telegram-login-approval` | offset、Web设置与会话落盘目录；与启动衔接配置保持一致 |

**配置缺失会直接抛错**，而不是静默退化成「无门禁」——这是安全路径，
不允许「忘配就等于不生效」。`publicOrigin` 与 `botUsername` 都是配置项，
源码里不写死任何具体域名或 Bot。面板设置保存后优先于 overlay 默认值；
期限设置立即用于新条目，旧会话/批准/已启动冷却保持原截止时间。
绑定/公开地址只在下次人工启动加载，面板同时显示运行值与待生效值。

## 原生 WebUI 远程设置

DSH **0.2.1-rc.2** 原生客户端已通过 `remote.settings.describe/mutate` 使用 Host 设置，不再依赖 loopback 选择表达式。
该版本建议 `remoteSettings: false`；即使保持 `true`，已注册的新客户端源码不匹配时也不会安装旧 registry 补丁。
没有实际适配的模块，其 rebuilt 仍委托原生方法；不猜测替换新版源码，不重打旧补丁。

默认开启的旧适配继续支持 DSH **0.2.0-rc.2** 的 `dsh-client-ui-settings` / `clientModules` 适配点。
经正常登录后在原生模型页配置，仍调用原生 `settings/describe/update/mutate`、`credentials/set` 等接口；
保存由 DSH 的 profile 配置编辑器和凭据 provider 完成。环境变量提供的只读 API Key 仍不可覆盖。
插件不伪造 `isLoopback`、不改全局 `fetch`、不放宽后端认证或其他 origin。

实现仅在内存中改原生 settings 模块的单一 host/memory 选择表达式，
使用当前运行 `publicOrigin`（已保存启动值优先）；TG 修改地址仍只在下次启动生效。
原生 registry 为转换后的源码生成独立模块/combo revision，source map 使用转换源码的 identity map；
HMR 再发布时仍适配同一模块，卸载恢复原始方法和当前上游源码。**不修改 DSH 安装文件**。

这是一项可选 UI 功能：缺 `clientModules` 不阻塞登录门禁；源码或接口不兼容时明确记录
`remoteSettings 未启用`，保留上游行为，门禁仍正常。DSH 升级后应检查该诊断并重新验证适配。
后续部署如果还有旧手工修改，可另行经批准恢复原版文件；本插件不自动修改它。
关闭功能也不会移除安装文件中已有的手工条件。完整边界见 [功能说明](docs/remote-settings.md)。

## 任务完成通知

订阅 `session/event` 与 `agent/status`，在一次「任务段」结束时推送一条消息。

**为什么不逐轮通知**：一个任务常跨多轮（工具调用、计划步骤），每轮结束都推会刷屏。
因此把轮次聚合成**任务段**：

1. 第一次 `turn/start` 开启任务段，后续轮次并入同一段；
2. agent 变 `idle` 后等待**静置窗口**（`SETTLE_MS = 800ms`）；
3. 窗口结束后**复查**：若期间又被排入新轮次，则取消通知（不误报完成）；
4. 确实空闲才推送一条，附轮次数、耗时、状态与最终回答。

状态：`✅ 完成` / `⏹ 已中止` / `❌ 失败` / `⚠️ 输出上限` / `⚠️ 进程重启中断`。
正文超过 3200 字符自动截断。

## 测试

```bash
npm install        # 只装 tsx
npm test
```

或在 DSH 仓库内直接运行：

```bash
cd /path/to/deepseek-harness
node --experimental-transform-types /path/to/dsh-telegram-login-approval/tests/gate.test.mts  # 新版调用方向，24 个用例
TLA_TEST_CONNECTION_MODE=legacy node --experimental-transform-types /path/to/dsh-telegram-login-approval/tests/gate.test.mts  # 同一套用例，旧版调用方向
node --experimental-transform-types /path/to/dsh-telegram-login-approval/tests/task-watch.test.mts  # 12 个用例
```

全部用例不需要真实 Bot

plugins.description: The machine's non-pwsh execution surfaces as one DSH tool: a WSL Linux userland, nushell's structured pipelines, the MSYS2 userland (bash/zsh/fish/brush), and a real console for interactive programs.
plugins.readme_text: # dsh-shell-surfaces [![test](https://github.com/Nesarf/dsh-shell-surfaces/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Nesarf/dsh-shell-surfaces/actions/workflows/test.yml) [![licence: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/licence-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) `https://github.com/Nesarf/dsh-shell-surfaces` -- a DSH plugin, installed with `dsh plugin --profile add github:Nesarf/dsh-shell-surfaces`. The badge is the whole test workflow: the pure self-test, and the two-runner probe that asks every shell on Windows and on Linux what it is. A green badge therefore means "the table and the argv shape still hold, and both platforms still answered", not just "the linter passed". One DSH tool for the execution surfaces this machine has: a WSL Linux userland, nushell's structured pipelines, the MSYS2 userland (bash / zsh / fish / brush), PowerShell itself, and a real console for interactive programs. It exists because a rule that is only written down is not a capability. The selection rules for these surfaces have been recorded for a while, but a session could only act on them by composing a command string for pwsh and hoping the quoting survived the trip. Here they are callable. ``` shell_surfaces(action="surfaces") what exists here, and where each was looked for shell_surfaces(action="run", surface="wsl", command="grep -P '(?<=Linux )[0-9.]+' /proc/version") shell_surfaces(action="run", surface="nu", command="open data.json | where n > 3 | to json") shell_surfaces(action="run", surface="msys", command="pacman -Q | wc -l") shell_surfaces(action="run", surface="pwsh", command="Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem | Select-Object Caption") shell_surfaces(action="run", surface="pty", command="powershell -File install.ps1", send=["y\n"]) ``` ## PowerShell is a surface here "Fall back to pwsh" used to mean "leave this tool and use the other one". The `pwsh` surface closes that gap: a PowerShell command is an ordinary call here, the same shape as every other surface, so a session that hits an awkward surface does not have to change its tool to get a PowerShell job done. Background jobs, timeout promotion, escalation approval and persistent sessions work on it as well -- they are surface features here, not privileges of one tool. Both PowerShells are addressable, and that took two entries rather than one. `pwsh` is PowerShell 7 and is the better default; `powershell` is the 5.1 that ships with Windows. Keeping them behind a single `DSH_PWSH` variable meant a machine holding both could reach only one of them, while "does this script still work on 5.1" is a question two surfaces answer and one variable cannot. The one shape this tool does not carry is a terminal session that keeps a drawn prompt or a cursor. That is where the built-in `pwsh` tool still earns its place; "the command is PowerShell" is not a reason to go there. A surface-level failure is also not a reason to change tools. When a surface is absent, cannot spawn, or times out, the tool says so and names the next call (`action="surfaces"`) that stays inside this plugin; the failure is about the surface, not about the tool. ## Background work stays here too `run_in_background: true` starts the command as a job and returns its id: the output ring streams it, `job_output` reads it, `job_kill` stops it. No timeout applies. `promote_on_timeout: true` turns a timeout into that same job instead of killing the process -- the output collected before the budget expired is handed over exactly once, and the rest keeps streaming. That is why the built-in `pwsh` tool now covers only approval/sandbox escalation and the persistent session: the job machinery no longer sends a session back to it. A composition without the `jobs` service gets a refusal sentence for a background request rather than a job nobody can collect, and the `pty` surface has no background mode at all, because a console transcript is read while the program is alive. ## The same sandbox as the built-in shell tools A confined deployment confines this tool too. Each call resolves the session's policy through `ctx.sandboxPolicy`, wraps the exact argv it is about to spawn through `ctx.sandbox.confine`, and reports the mode, enforcement and denial facts in the same vocabulary the built-in shell tools use. `danger-full-access` never consults the provider, and a composition without the sandbox services runs exactly as before. A file effect the mode denies is a policy answer, not a command failure. `sandbox_permissions` plus `justification` asks `ctx.approval` for exactly one wider call -- the grant is consumed by that call and never persisted -- and an escalation that is refused, cancelled or has no approval channel stops before anything runs. The same-turn denial hint rides the tool result, so the sanctioned retry does not depend on recalling the description. ## Persistent sessions Pass `session: ` to run a command inside one long-lived shell per (agent, surface, name): the current directory, variables and modules persist across calls, and `session_reset: true` starts a fresh one. The session is a process with a pipe, not a terminal -- a random nonce line marks where one command's output ends, which is the only signal every supported shell (`pwsh`, `msys`) prints without a prompt. A session runs one command at a time, so the job flags are refused with it, and `pty` has no session at all: a console transcript is read while the program is alive. ## Finding this machine's shells The table is a set of defaults, and the scan is what makes them true on a machine that moved its installs. The model is borrowed from mega-index-map's `library_detect`: a built-in candidate table (shell names, the usual install roots, the WSL launcher) resolved against PATH and this machine's own locations, with every hit carrying where it was found. A scan costs one PATH listing per directory, a few `stat` calls, one `wsl -l -q`, and one `command -v` inside each distribution -- it is not a walk of the drive. What the scan adds to the table: | Found | Becomes | |---|---| | a WSL distribution other than the default | its own `wsl-` surface | | a Git-for-Windows or Cygwin bash | a `git-bash` surface (the MSYS2 one keeps `msys`) | | `cmd.exe` | a `cmd` surface (`cmd /c`) | | a terminal program (`wt`, `mintty`, `wezterm`, ...) | reported in `action="surfaces"` under `discovered`, not a surface: a terminal draws text, it does not interpret commands | | a terminal installed inside a distribution (`kitty`, `tmux`, `screen`) | reported with `wsl:` as its source; the Windows PATH cannot see it | | `tcsh` or BusyBox in the MSYS2 userland | surfaces of their own: `tcsh` (`-c`) and `busybox` (`sh -c`) | | `dash` in the MSYS2 userland | a `dash` surface: the strict POSIX sh, where a bash-ism fails instead of being forgiven | | a shell installed inside a distribution (`elvish`, `ksh`, `xonsh`, `mksh`, `tcsh`, BusyBox) | its own `wsl-` surface, which runs *that* shell rather than bash | | `oils-for-unix` in a distribution | two faces, `wsl-osh` and `wsl-ysh`: the bash-compatible half and the strict half that rejects what bash forgives | A shell that lives inside a distribution used to be reachable only by writing `bash -lc 'elvish -c ...'` by hand -- a wrapper the caller had to quote correctly every time, for a shell the scan had already found. `wsl-elvish` (and its siblings) run the shell itself: the command is written to the distribution's stdin as `exec elvish -c ''`, so the outer bash gets one word it passes through untouched. `wsl-bash` does not exist on purpose -- `wsl` already is bash. ### The command travels on stdin, not as an argument `wsl.exe` recomposes the words it was handed into one command line and hands that line to the distribution, where it is parsed once more. A `$VAR` in an argument was therefore expanded by a shell that had never run the loop defining it. Measured 2026-10-20, through this surface: ``` for n in alpha beta; do echo "n=[$n]"; done -> n=[] and n=[] (wanted alpha, beta) echo 'single=

# dsh-hard-delete

> **仓库**：<https://github.com/qwe4888789/dsh-hard-delete>
> **许可**：AGPL-3.0-only（+ 商业授权，见第九节） ｜ **版本**：v0.1.0 ｜ **类型**：cordis 插件（host + client 双半，零运行时依赖）

在 DSH 的侧边栏会话「…」菜单里加一行 **删除** —— 点一下就把这个会话**彻底删掉**：

- **不可恢复**：直接物理删除，不进回收站、没有回滚。
- **不设门槛**：不看「疑似还在活动」，不要求二次输入，只弹一次确认框（因为不可逆）。
- **当前会话也能删**：确认框会明确提示「这正是你当前打开的会话，删完请切换或刷新」。
- **删完整**：会话目录之外，还清掉指向它的 projcache 条目与 `workspace.json` 引用，
  避免留下悬空元数据。

> 与同机另一个插件 **`dsh-session-recycle`** 的分工：
> 那个是设置页里的「软删 → 回收站 → 恢复 / 回滚」，保守、可救回；
> 这个是菜单里的一键硬删。两者互不干扰（本插件不碰 `_recycle-bin/`）。

---

## 一、形态与注册

本插件**同时**声明 `dsh.bundle` 与 `dsh.client`，因此走 **bundle 层**注册：

```json
"dsh": {
  "bundle": { "patch": "./cordis.patch.yml" },
  "client": { "inject": [], "platform": "web" }
}
```

> `dsh.client.inject` 刻意留空：本插件浏览器半只 `require("react")`（平台种子词）。
> 为什么不去 require 官方 UI 组件库，见第六节第 7 条。

> ⚠️ 只有 `dsh.client` 而**没有** `dsh.bundle` 的插件不能进 `dsh.profile.bundles` ——
> 宿主会以 `declares no dsh.bundle` 拒绝并**启动即崩**。本插件两个都声明了，所以不受此限。

装到某个 profile：

```bash
# 方式 A（推荐）：让 DSH 自己装 —— 桌面端「插件 → 添加插件」里粘贴本仓地址，
#   或命令行（profile 名按你的实际环境改）：
dsh plugin --profile web add qwe4888789/dsh-hard-delete

# 方式 B：声明式手工安装
#   在 <DSH_HOME>/profiles/<name>/package.json 里
#     dependencies:        { "dsh-hard-delete": "link:<本仓路径>" }
#     dsh.profile.bundles: 追加 "dsh-hard-delete"
cd <DSH_HOME>/profiles/<name> && pnpm install
# 重启 DSH
```

> 桌面版（DeepSeek Harness 桌面端）的 `desktop` profile 由 Electron 应用独占，
> 别用 `dsh plugin --profile desktop …`（CLI 会直接拒绝）；桌面端请走「插件 → 添加插件」。

---

## 二、两个槽位

| 槽位 | 挂什么 | 为什么 |
|---|---|---|
| `sidebar.workspaces.session.menu.item` | 菜单里的「删除」行（id `hard-delete`，order **500**，排在 archive 的 400 之后） | owner 注入 `{ sessionId, displayTitle }` 与 `useMenuOpenState` 钩子 |
| `shell.overlay` | 确认框 + 结果提示 | **必须挂在常驻浮层上**：确认框若挂在菜单项里，菜单一关它就跟着卸载了 |

菜单项只做一件事：把「待确认请求」写进模块级小 store，然后关掉菜单。
浮层里的对话框读同一个 store，所以在菜单卸载后依然活着。

界面**自绘**（官方 `MenuItemButton` / `Modal` / `Button` / `Toast` 拿不到，见第六节第 7 条），
但完全照官方 `Menu.module.css` 的规格来：`min-height:34px` / `padding:6px 8px` /
`gap:6px` / `border-radius: var(--dsw-radius-md)` / hover 用
`--dsw-alias-interactive-bg-hover`，危险行用 `--dsw-alias-state-error-primary` +
`--dsw-alias-interactive-bg-hover-danger`。DOM 也与官方同构：
`div > [role=separator] + button[role=menuitem]` —— 菜单的键盘遍历与焦点回收都是读 DOM 的，
自绘按钮同样能参与。每个 `var()` 都写了兜底值，主题变量缺失时不会变成透明。

---

## 三、host 半的路由

前缀可配（默认 `/api/dsh-hard-delete`），全部 **loopback-only + same-origin 校验**。

| 方法 | 路径 | 请求体 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/config` | — | 公开配置（`apiPrefix` / 文案覆盖 / 开关 / `configErrors`），**不含绝对路径** |
| POST | `/inspect` | `{sessionId}` | 一个会话的概况：标题 / 工作目录 / 大小 / 文件数 / 有无线索日志 |
| POST | `/delete` | `{sessionId, confirm:true}` | **彻底删除**（不可逆） |

错误统一 `{ error, code }`。值得注意的 code：`session-not-found`(404)、
`confirm-required`(400)、`invalid-sessionId`(400)、`path-escape`(400)、
`loopback-only`(403)、`body-too-large`(413)。

返回列表里**不含任何绝对路径**——界面只显示标题 / 工作目录 / 大小 / 文件数。

---

## 四、删一个会话要动几处

```
<DSH_HOME>/
├─ sessions/<projectKey>/<sessionId>/
│  └─ session[.v<N>].jsonl[.zstd]        ← ① 整个目录物理删除（多版本日志一起）
├─ storages/
│  ├─ session_projcache/sessions/<id>.json  ← ② 新版：每会话一个文件
│  ├─ session_projcache.json                ← ③ 旧版：tables.sessions[<id>]
│  └─ workspace.json                        ← ④ archivedSessionIds / pinnedSessionIds
│                                              / tables.workspaces[*].sessionIds
└─ （浏览器那一边）
   └─ ctx.emit('api-session/removed', id)   ← ⑤ 让侧边栏那一行立刻消失
```

安全性质：

- **路径纵深防御**：`sessionId` 必须是单层路径段（挡 `.` / `..` / 分隔符 / NUL），
  定位后再用 `relative()` 确认最终目录没跑出 `sessions/`。
- **只认精确路径**：只在 `sessions/<任意项目目录>/<精确的 sessionId>` 下动手，
  绝不复刻宿主的目录名编码规则（也就不会被规则变化带偏）。
- **不覆盖、不猜**：定位不到就是 404，什么都不做。
- **元数据清理失败不冒充删除失败**：降级成 `warnings` 如实回传，界面照实提示。
- **原子写 JSON**：先写 `.tmp-<pid>-<ts>` 再 rename，网络盘上失败也不留半个文件。
- **只读探测**：`/inspect` 全程不写盘。

---

## 五、七个实测踩出来的坑（本节是这份代码最有价值的部分）

1. **多帧 zstd：Node 的同步接口只解第一帧。** DSH 的会话日志是**多帧拼接**的。
   `zstdDecompressSync(整个文件)` 实测在 107 KB 的文件上只吐 187 字节（就第一帧），
   `zlib.createZstdDecompress()` 流也一样停在第一帧。必须按 magic `28 B5 2F FD`
   切帧、逐帧解。第一版没做这件事，标题/工作目录大面积读不出来。

2. **头部解码要「帧数 + 字节」双限。** 帧大小不固定（实测 1.5 KB ~ 35 KB 都有），
   只限帧数会漏后文，只限字节会白解一堆帧。两个都设，取先到的那个；
   并且 magic 也可能出现在压缩数据内部，解不开就跳过，靠 JSON 解析兜住误判。

3. **projcache 有两种布局，都得清。** 实测 `<home>/storages/session_projcache/sessions/<id>.json`
   与 `<home>/storages/session_projcache.json` 的 `tables.sessions[<id>]` 同时存在。
   只清一种就会留下悬空条目。

4. **存在「空壳」会话目录。** 真实 `~/.dsh` 里有目录建了但没写成日志的会话
   （实测 15 个会话目录里有 1 个）。如果「必须扫到日志才算会话」，
   这类目录就永远删不掉。改成：**目录名精确等于 sessionId 就认**，
   日志有无只作为 `hasLog` 事实回传。

5. **侧边栏那一行不会自己消失 —— 但有一条现成的事件。**
   客户端 `ctx.sessions`（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-session-controller` 的 client 半）
   通过 `ctx.remote.$on('api-session/added' | 'api-session/removed', …)` 维护会话列表；
   宿主侧 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-remotes` 把这批宿主 Cordis 事件原样转发给浏览器。
   所以删完文件只要 `ctx.emit('api-session/removed', sessionId)`，那一行立刻消失，
   不必等下一次 list 刷新，也不必自己去动客户端的列表状态。

6. **删除当前会话受 Windows 文件语义影响。** 宿主对日志文件是**持有句柄持续追加写**的。
   Node/libuv 打开文件时带 `FILE_SHARE_DELETE`，所以删除通常能成功（名字立刻消失），
   但宿主后台仍可能在写那个已经 unlink 的文件。因此确认框里明确写了
   「若它正在运行，建议删完重启一次 DSH」。

7. **`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives` 在浏览器里 require 不到。**
   浏览器端模块表里只有两类东西：平台种子词（react 一族）和**声明了 `dsh.client`
   的 Loader 条目**。primitives 两个都不是 —— 它没有 `dsh.client`，在插件树里也没有
   对应条目（实测 201 条 Loader 条目里没有它）；官方客户端插件是在**构建期**把它内联
   进自己 bundle 的。所以第三方插件要么自己上构建，要么自己画。本插件选择自己画，
   但严格照官方 `Menu.module.css` 的规格与主题变量来（见第二节）。
   推论：`dsh.client.inject` 里写一个不存在的包名不会报错（只是解析不到），
   真正会炸的是运行时的 `require` —— 所以本插件只 `require("react")`。

---

## 六、配置

`<DSH_HOME>/hard-delete.config.json`（可选；env 优先）。载入一次常驻，改完**重启 DSH** 生效。

```json
{
  "apiPrefix": "/api/dsh-hard-delete",
  "cleanMetadata": true,
  "emitRemovedEvent": true,
  "maxFiles": 20000,
  "headerFrames": 32,
  "headerScanBytes": 262144,
  "text": {}
}
```

env 覆盖：`DSH_HOME`、`HARD_DELETE_CONFIG`、`HARD_DELETE_API_PREFIX`。

`text` 段可按 key 覆盖界面文案（前端内置 zh 字典兜底；默认下发空表 = 不覆盖）。
`cleanMetadata:false` = 只删会话目录，留元数据；`emitRemovedEvent:false` = 不发那一行消失事件。

---

## 七、测试

```bash
node _test/test-host.mjs           # 39 项夹具断言，全在临时目录里跑，不碰真实会话
node _test/test-client.mjs         # 11 项客户端离线断言（最小 hooks 运行时跑一遍渲染）
node _test/smoke-real-readonly.mjs # 对真实 ~/.dsh 只读冒烟（不做任何写操作）
node _test/verify-e2e-copy.mjs     # 把真实 home 复制一份，走完整 HTTP 栈删一个真会话
```

夹具单测覆盖：多项目定位、版本号文件名、多帧 zstd 头部解码、两种 projcache 布局、
空壳目录、路径穿越、dryRun、workspace.json 引用清理、删除后 404、
loopback / Host / 跨站 / 跨源 / 405 / 非法 JSON / 413 / `confirm` 校验 /
`api-session/removed` 的发出与关闭开关。

客户端离线单测覆盖：factory 形态、**只 require `react`**、两个槽位的 id/order/locale、
文案 key 全部有兜底、菜单项 DOM 与官方同构且点击后关菜单并写入请求、
确认框三条警告齐全且默认焦点在「取消」、缺 slots API 时明确报错、
sessions 服务取不到时降级不炸。

`verify-e2e-copy.mjs` 是最后一道闸：真实会话目录里的多版本日志、真实 projcache
与 workspace.json，走完整链路删掉一个真会话后逐项核对，**真实库全程只读**。

---

## 八、明确不做的事（以及为什么）

- **不做回收站 / 回滚**：本插件就是「删掉」这一个动作。要可恢复请用 `dsh-session-recycle`。
- **不做活动守卫**：用户要的是「自由删除」，加守卫就回到了软删插件的语义。
  取而代之的是确认框里把风险讲清楚（不可恢复 / 当前会话 / 可能仍在写盘）。
- **不改主包的会话列表状态**：只发一个宿主事件，列表由客户端自己维护。
- **不碰宿主服务**：只 `inject: ['webServer']`，不 import 会话/工作区服务。
- **不返回绝对路径**：前端显示不了也不需要。

---

## 九、许可

**AGPL-3.0-only**（GNU Affero General Public License v3.0），全文见 [LICENSE](./LICENSE)。

本项目管理在 **AGPL-3.0** 下开放：个人、学习、开源项目可自由使用与修改。
若需在 **闭源** 或 **商业场景** 中使用（不愿承接 AGPL 的传染条款），请联系获取**商业授权** ——
本仓暂无公开的联系邮箱，**请通过本仓 Issue 联系**。

本仓自 v0.1.0 起即为 AGPL-3.0，尚无许可变更历史。

本仓代码为**独立实现**：实现时观察了宿主公开的运行时约定（HTTP 路由注册方式 `ctx.webServer.register`、
客户端打包形态 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load`、槽位注册 `ctx.slots.inject/register`、
磁盘布局与日志文件名、转发事件 allowlist）与官方 `Menu.module.css` 的公开样式规格；
**未复制任何第三方插件代码**。命名上刻意避开 npm 上已被占用的 `dsh-session-delete` / `dsh-session-recycle`。

---

## 十、发布与收录

- 发布流程、版本号策略与推送步骤见 [docs/RELEASING.md](docs/RELEASING.md)；
  推送脚本 [scripts/push-publish.mjs](scripts/push-publish.mjs)（token 只从环境变量读，不落盘、不进 git 配置）。
- **远端只有 GitHub**：插件市场按 GitHub 仓库索引，Gitee 镜像对本仓没有收益，故不做。
- **插件市场收录**：[dshbase](https://dshbase.com/) 与 [DSH 插件市场](https://github.com/bradeGithub/DSH-Plugins-Marketplace)
  按 GitHub 仓库的 **`dsh-plugin` topic 自动索引**（每 2 小时扫一次）。本仓的 topic：
  `dsh-plugin` · `dsh` · `deepseek-harness` · `cordis-plugin`。
- 市场按 `package.json` 的 `version` 判断更新；**发版必须 bump version**（见 CHANGELOG）。

plugins.description: Tavily-backed WebSearchProvider for the DeepSeek Harness web capability seam (ctx.web) — npm: dsh-tavily-cxykyw
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-tavily-cxykyw

[English](README.md) | [中文](README.zh.md) A [Tavily](https://tavily.com)-backed `WebSearchProvider` for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) web capability seam (`ctx.web`). It routes the built-in `web_search` tool to Tavily's dedicated search API instead of the shipped DeepSeek model-based search channel, so **a search costs no model tokens** and the result set comes from a real search engine index rather than an auxiliary model request. Verified against DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`. > Package name note: `dsh-web-search-tavily` on npm belongs to another author. This plugin is published as **`dsh-tavily-cxykyw`**; the GitHub repository is still `cxykyw/dsh-web-search-tavily`. ## What it does - registers a search provider with the stable id **`tavily`** on `ctx.web`; - maps Tavily's response to DSH's normalized `WebSearchResult` — `results[].url/title/content` become `sources[].url/title/snippet`, and Tavily's optional `answer` becomes the result `content`; - resolves the API key on **every** search, in this order: literal `apiKey` → credentials service (`~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`) → launch environment / `process.env`; - `available()` is a cheap local check (key + base URL present) with no network calls — a missing key surfaces as `WEB_PROVIDER_CREDENTIAL_MISSING` at search time; - then truncates to `request.maxResults` through the seam, exactly like any other provider. ## Install ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-tavily-cxykyw ``` If your DSH profile is a pnpm workspace root (the default `~/.dsh/profiles/web` is), the add must target the workspace root: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-tavily-cxykyw -w ``` The bundled `cordis.patch.yml` declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, so adding the package also registers it as a profile bundle: the provider row is inserted **and** `web.searchProvider` is set to `tavily` for you. Restart `dsh web` afterwards — bundle changes are not hot-reloaded. From a checkout instead of npm: ```sh git clone https://github.com/cxykyw/dsh-web-search-tavily.git dsh plugin --profile web add link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-web-search-tavily -w ``` ## Configure the API key Get a key at [app.tavily.com](https://app.tavily.com) (there is a free tier). Then pick **one** of: **1. Credentials file (recommended — outside every repository):** ```yaml # ~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml TAVILY_API_KEY: tvly-xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx ``` **2. Environment variable** of the process that launches DSH: ```sh TAVILY_API_KEY=tvly-xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx dsh web ``` **3. Literal key in your own profile patch** (works, but keeps the secret in a plain file — prefer 1 or 2): ```yaml # ~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml - id: web-search-tavily config: apiKey: tvly-xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx ``` > **Never commit an API key.** This repository, its `cordis.patch.yml`, and its published npm tarball contain **no** credentials and no default key: the plugin only ever reads them from your machine at search time. `.gitignore` also excludes `.env*`, `.npmrc`, and `*.local.yml`. ## Options Configurable on the inserted `web-search-tavily` row: | Option | Default | Description | | --- | --- | --- | | `apiKey` | — | Literal Tavily API key. Prefer `apiKeyEnv` + credentials/env. | | `apiKeyEnv` | `TAVILY_API_KEY` | Credential reference / environment variable name to resolve the key from. | | `baseURL` | `https://api.tavily.com` | Tavily API base URL (point it at a proxy if you need one). | | `searchDepth` | `basic` | `basic` (fast, 1 credit) or `advanced` (deeper crawl, more credits). | | `maxResults` | `8` | Results requested per search, 1–20. A per-call `maxResults` still wins. | Example, overriding just the depth and result count: ```yaml # ~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml - id: web-search-tavily config: searchDepth: advanced maxResults: 5 ``` ## Switching providers The bundle patch already pins the seam: ```yaml - id: web config: searchProvider: tavily fetchProvider: http ``` To fall back to the official DeepSeek search, set `searchProvider: deepseek-official` (or remove the line only if `deepseek-official` is the single usable provider — with two usable providers and no pin, the seam fails closed with `WEB_PROVIDER_AMBIGUOUS`). > Upgrading from a hand-inserted copy in your own profile patch? Delete that `insert` block and keep only the `- id: web-search-tavily` config override above, otherwise the row id is inserted twice. ## Notes and limitations - No Web settings page: DSH `0.2` cannot mount this plugin's settings section, so the provider is configured through the profile patch only. - `fetch` (page retrieval) is untouched — it stays on `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-fetch-http`. - Tavily search results carry no publication date, so `sources[].publishedAt` is not set. ## Uninstall ```sh dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-tavily-cxykyw -w ``` ## License MIT © cxykyw

plugins.description: Sign in to ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot and other subscription model routes inside the DeepSeek Harness — the sign-in button the Harness never shipped.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-subscription-signin

[![tests](https://github.com/amosogra/dsh-subscription-signin/actions/workflows/tests.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/amosogra/dsh-subscription-signin/actions/workflows/tests.yml)

**The sign-in button the DeepSeek Harness never shipped.**

Use the AI subscriptions you already pay for — ChatGPT Plus/Pro, Claude Pro/Max,
GitHub Copilot, and more — as model routes inside the
[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). Adds a
**Subscriptions** settings page plus a compact extension on every provider card
in **Settings → Models**.

```text
Settings → Subscriptions → ChatGPT (Codex) → [ Sign in with ChatGPT (Codex) ]
                                    ↓
                    github.com/login/device  ·  code ABCD-1234
                                    ↓
                    ✓ Signed in — draws on your plan
```

No password is ever collected or stored by this plugin. The vendor runs the
sign-in on its own page; the Harness credential store writes the token.

## Repository layout

The **installable package is the `dsh-subscription-signin/` directory.** The
tests, license and documentation sit beside it and are not part of the package:

```text
dsh-subscription-signin/   ← the package; this is what you install
  host.js                  ← the Host half (tool + HTTP route)
  client.js                ← the Client half (settings page + provider card)
  cordis.patch.yml         ← the accounts, as configuration
  locale/en.json           ← package metadata strings
  package.json
smoketest/                 ← five dependency-free suites (run from the root)
docs/FINDINGS.md           ← what was measured vs inferred
```

---

## Why this exists

The Harness already ships everything needed to *use* a subscription as a model
route. Its LLM adapter registers OAuth flows for eight providers — the transport
works, the token exchange works, the credential store works.

What it has no surface for is **starting** one. Nothing in the GUI or CLI ever
calls the authorization seam's `begin()`. This plugin is that missing surface.

It implements **no OAuth**. It does not touch PKCE, state, device codes, or token
parsing — all of that lives in `@earendil-works/pi-ai`, shipped by DeepSeek. This
plugin asks the Harness to begin a flow, shows you the URL and code, and reports
the result.

## Supported providers

Configured out of the box, driven through the Harness's own authorization seam:

| Provider | Credential | Login style |
|---|---|---|
| ChatGPT (Codex) | `llm-pi-ai/openai-codex` | device code |
| Claude (Pro/Max) | `llm-pi-ai/anthropic` | OAuth |
| GitHub Copilot | `llm-pi-ai/github-copilot` | device code |
| xAI | `llm-pi-ai/xai` | device code |
| Meta | `llm-pi-ai/meta` | device code |
| OpenRouter | `llm-pi-ai/openrouter` | OAuth + paste fallback |
| Radius | `llm-pi-ai/radius` | browser callback |
| Kimi For Coding | `llm-pi-ai/kimi-coding` | device code |

**Honest status.** Sign-in is verified end to end for **ChatGPT (Codex)** and
**Claude (Pro/Max)**; Claude's route was observed authenticating successfully and
then being rate-limited by the account (HTTP 429 with Anthropic's own
`request_id` — a quota answer, not a credential failure). Copilot's flow is
verified and completes. xAI, Meta, OpenRouter, Radius and Kimi hold credentials
that have been written successfully, but **no request has been served on those
routes in the session where this was verified**, so treat them as untested rather
than broken. `docs/FINDINGS.md` records what is measured versus inferred.

## Install

**Requirements.** DeepSeek Harness `0.2.0-rc.2` or later. Developed and verified
against `0.2.0-rc.2`, the release this plugin's two seams were checked on
(`ctx.authorization` from `@deepseek-ai/dsh-authorization`, and the client
`slots` service). Every Harness service it consumes is reached with a defensive
`ctx.get(...)` plus an undefined check, so a missing one degrades to a reported
message instead of a crash — but a Harness that has moved a seam will still need
a matching plugin release.

The plugin is installed into a Harness **profile** as a bundle. Point the plugin
manager at this directory:

```text
install_bundle: link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-subscription-signin
```

Or, if you publish/consume it as a package, install by name and add it to your
profile's bundle list:

```jsonc
// $DSH_PROFILE_DIR/package.json
"dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": ["@deepseek-ai/dsh-base", "@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app", "dsh-subscription-signin"] } }
```

Then **restart DSH once.** This matters and is explained under
[Troubleshooting](#troubleshooting) — the client half is composed into the
browser's boot graph at startup, so a freshly installed bundle has no page until
the process restarts.

## Use

From the GUI: **Settings → Subscriptions**, pick an account, press *Sign in*.

For an agent, or a headless harness, the same implementation is exposed as a tool
with actions `status`, `start`, `poll`, `cancel`, `signout`, `submitCode` and
`diagnostics`. Read `status` first; `start` returns the URL and, for device
grants, the code you enter on the vendor's page.

## Safety

This section is the reason to trust the plugin, so it is specific rather than
reassuring.

**It never sees a secret.** No password, token, API key or refresh token is read,
written, logged, or forwarded. The token is produced and stored by the Harness
credential seam (`ctx.authorization` / `ctx.credentials`), not by this code.
Audit it yourself — it is two files:

- **`host.js`** — zero imports. No filesystem access, no network requests, no
  child processes. It asks the credential store *whether* a record exists, and
  can delete one on explicit `signout` with `confirm: true`; it never reads a
  token value. The one `process.env` write is the documented per-account `env`
  field (used so a provider that selects its endpoint from the environment can be
  configured per account), and it is restored when the attempt settles.
- **`client.js`** — one dependency, `react`, supplied by the page. Its only
  `fetch` calls go to the plugin's own `/plugins/subscription-signin` route on
  your local Harness. Nothing is rendered from a credential.

**The one network-bearing route is trust-gated.** The panel reaches the Host half
over an HTTP route that inherits the Harness's own checks
(`connection.requestRejection`: Host/Origin validation and browser
authentication). On top of that, every mutating call must be a JSON `POST`, which
forces a CORS preflight and blocks form-based CSRF; bodies are capped at 64 KiB;
responses are `no-store` + `nosniff`.

**Not sanctioned by the vendors — read this.** For ChatGPT-plan usage, the
Harness targets the ChatGPT/Codex backend
(`chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex`), which OpenAI's developer documentation tells
third-party apps not to target for plan usage. **This plugin surfaces behaviour
the Harness already ships; it does not introduce it and cannot change it.** The
sanctioned path for third-party apps is *Sign in with ChatGPT*, which the Harness
does not implement. Using a subscription outside a vendor's intended client may
conflict with that vendor's terms, and vendors may rate-limit or block such
traffic. You are choosing to do that with your own account. Do not use this to
resell access, and do not use it to reach credentials that are not yours.

**No credentials are in this repository.** If you ever find one here, that is a
bug — please open an issue. The repository was scanned for tokens, private keys,
home paths and email addresses before its first commit. `docs/FINDINGS.md` does
cite exact package versions and source symbols from the Harness, which is
deliberate: a claim about a specific build is only useful if it names the build.

**Found a vulnerability?** Report it privately via
[SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) rather than a public issue. That file also lists what
is and is not in scope — worth reading first, because the unofficial-backend
caveat above is a documented trade-off rather than a defect, and the two are easy
to confuse.

## Configuration

Accounts are configured, not hardcoded. They live in this package's own
[`cordis.patch.yml`](dsh-subscripti

plugins.description: 去掉 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）「当前模型不支持图片」的拒绝限制：不改 app.asar，用运行时接缝放行未声明多模态能力的模型
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-vision-unlock

去掉 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai)（DSH）「当前模型不支持图片」的拒绝限制，让未声明多模态能力的模型也能发送和读取图片。

不修改 `app.asar` 里任何一行代码，也不改配置树——纯运行时接缝，随 DSH 升级继续可用。

## 为什么会被拒绝

DSH 判定一条路由能否吃图片，依据两处能力声明：

- **`LlmModelInfo.inputModalities`**（可选字段）。缺这个字段，或数组里没有 `"image"`，
  就被当成纯文本模型。这是**所有门禁**的唯一判定来源：

  | 位置 | 表现 |
  |---|---|
  | 会话控制器 `prompt()` | 发送时弹「当前模型不支持图片，请切换支持图片的模型」 |
  | 子代理 `assertImageCapable` | 向子代理发图被拒 |
  | `read_file` 读图 | `does not declare image input` |
  | MCP / ACP 图片注入 | 同上 |

- **适配器自己持有的模型表**（不经过上面那处）。pi-ai 在发请求前查
  `model.input.includes("image")`；deepseek 适配器序列化前查
  `connection.models[].inputModalities`。

**典型触发场景**：自定义/本地网关路由（如 Agent2API、自建 OpenAI 兼容网关）在配置里只写了
`id / name / contextWindow / maxTokens`，没写 `input`，于是落到默认值 `["text"]`，
被判定为不支持图片——哪怕上游模型其实支持。

## 本插件怎么做

只用两个运行时接缝：

1. 包装 `llm.resolveModelInfo`，给结果补上 `"image"` → 拆掉上表中所有门禁。
2. 遍历 `llm.adapters`，把适配器模型表里的 `input` / `inputModalities` 补上
   `"image"` → 拆掉 pi-ai 的自检。适配器换快照（配置热更新）时自动重做。

## 安装

### 方式 A：用 `plugin_manager` 安装（推荐）

在 DSH 里让 agent 执行：

```
plugin_manager  action: install_bundle  target: github:wmk66ds/dsh-vision-unlock
```

或在 Web UI 的 **设置 → 插件** 面板里，把上面这串填进安装框。

`target` 也可以写完整 URL，两种等价：

| 写法 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `github:wmk66ds/dsh-vision-unlock` | GitHub 简写，推荐 |
| `https://github.com/wmk66ds/dsh-vision-unlock` | 完整 git URL |

锁定版本用 `#` 加 ref：

```
github:wmk66ds/dsh-vision-unlock#v1.0.0
```

> 若本机访问 GitHub 不畅，DSH 走的是它自己的网络栈；必要时先确认你的代理环境
> 能被 DSH 进程继承（例如 Clash Verge 的 TUN / 系统代理）。

### 方式 B：手动安装（CLI 或插件管理不可用时的降级方案）

1. 把本仓库放到一个稳定的路径，例如 `D:\workbench\dsh-vision-unlock`。
2. 在你的 profile 目录（默认 `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/`）的 `node_modules` 下建立指向它的链接：

   ```powershell
   cmd /c "mklink /J `"%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop\node_modules\dsh-vision-unlock`" `"D:\workbench\dsh-vision-unlock`""
   ```

3. 编辑该 profile 的 `package.json`，在 `dsh.profile.bundles` 数组加入 `"dsh-vision-unlock"`，
   并在 `dependencies` 加入 `"dsh-vision-unlock": "link:D:/workbench/dsh-vision-unlock"`。
4. 重启 DSH。

> Windows 上用 **junction**（`mklink /J`）而不是符号链接——后者需要管理员权限。
> 注意 desktop profile 由 Electron 应用独占管理，`dsh plugin --profile desktop`
> 会拒绝执行，所以才有这里的手动步骤。

## 配置

`cordis.patch.yml` 里的 `config`：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: vision-unlock
      name: 'dsh-vision-unlock'
      config:
        providers: []   # 留空 = 所有 provider；否则只放行列出的
        models: []      # 留空 = 所有模型；否则只放行列出的
```

两个白名单都为空时全部放行；非空时需**同时**命中才放行。

## 已知边界

- deepseek 适配器的模型表来自它自己的 plugin config，不经由 `llm.adapters` 暴露，
  本插件改不到。该路由如需图片，请在设置页给模型勾选 Image（等价于写
  `inputModalities: [text, image]`）。
- 放行后图片**真的会发出去**。若上游实际不支持多模态，报错会从模型侧返回，
  不再是 DSH 本地拒绝——这是预期行为，不是 bug。

## 卸载

从 profile 的 `package.json` 中删掉 `dsh-vision-unlock`（`bundles` 与 `dependencies` 两处），
删除 `node_modules/dsh-vision-unlock`，重启 DSH。

## 适用版本

针对 DSH 桌面版（含 `dsh-llm` / `dsh-llm-pi-ai` / `dsh-api-session-controller`）验证。
依赖的是 `llm.resolveModelInfo` 与 `llm.adapters` 这两个接口，若上游改动需要同步调整。

## 许可证

MIT

# Artifact Center · 产物中心

Find the file a DSH conversation produced, together with its workspace and conversation history.

[中文说明](README.zh-CN.md) · [Requirements](docs/requirements.zh.md) · [Acceptance record](docs/acceptance.zh.md) · [MIT](LICENSE)

## Features

- A global sidebar panel that works without an active conversation.
- Historical backfill from complete session events, including file writes, edits and explicitly presented deliverables.
- Live workspace snapshots at turn end to detect shell and subprocess outputs. Large output bursts are summarized rather than flooding the list.
- Workspace/tag/date filters, favorites, notes, bounded text-content search and a virtualized list. Check or uncheck extensions directly under “Readable formats” to control visibility; the choice is saved in this browser.
- Native image, PDF, Markdown, Mermaid, text/code, CSV/TSV, sandboxed HTML and media previews. Office files and binaries use the system's applications; no format conversion takes place.
- Conversation links, path/link copying, file-handler selection, provenance history and CSV/Markdown export.
- Missing-file checks and confirmed moves to the system trash. Retrieve a file using your file manager, then check files to restore its index status.
- A read-only `artifact_search` Agent tool and Chinese/English UI.

History records provenance and metadata; it **does not preserve old file contents**. Snapshot results are labeled as inferred because filesystem changes cannot prove which concurrent task caused them. Historical shell outputs that have no recorded path cannot be reconstructed from current files alone.
