plugins.description: Sage mode（贤者模式）: a read-only advisory session mode for DeepSeek Harness — answer, advise, review, teach, brainstorm, and diagnose with read/search/web tools only.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-sage-mode · Sage Mode

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

A **read-only advisory mode** for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) sessions.
Enter with `/sage`, leave with `/sage off`.

While the mode is active, the session keeps only read/search/web tools. Every tool that
edits, deletes, or executes is **hidden from the model** and **denied at execution**.
At the same time an advisory system-prompt section turns the model into your thinking
partner: it answers, advises, evaluates, explains, brainstorms, and diagnoses — instead of
changing your workspace.

The name comes from **Sage (贤者)**: the wise one gives counsel, not a hand.

## Why

Coding agents are built to act. Sometimes you do not want action — you want to understand
code, compare approaches, learn a concept, brainstorm, or debug an error. Sage mode gives
that intent a first-class switch: the agent can still read your repository and search the
web, but it cannot touch anything.

## Usage

| Input | Effect |
|---|---|
| `/sage` | Enter Sage mode: read-only tools only, advisory prompt injected |
| `/sage <question>` | Enter the mode **and** send that question as your next message (images/files allowed) |
| `/sage off` | Leave; the full toolset is restored immediately |

Typical uses: understanding an unfamiliar implementation, learning a codebase, comparing
design options, brainstorming, pasting a stack trace. When you are ready to actually change
code, run `/sage off`.

Entering the mode changes what the model can call, not the sandbox: hidden tools are removed
from the request's tool catalog entirely, and anything that still reaches dispatch is refused
by a `tools.guard()` that returns "let the user run `/sage off` first".

## Tools kept (default)

`read` `read_image` `glob` `grep` `web_search` `web_fetch` `ask_user_question` `skill`
`cordis_inspect_list` `cordis_inspect_query` `load_workspace_dependencies`

Everything else is hidden — `write` `edit` `ops_replace`, `pwsh`/`bash` and background jobs,
`subagent`/`send_message`, `plugin_manager`, `todo_write`, `present`, goal and team-task
tools, and so on. Names that do not exist in your composition are ignored, so one list works
across agent presets.

## Reference

### Optional dependency: dsh-ops

The fast read-only tools — `ops_glob`, `ops_grep`, `ops_inspect_local_file` — come from
**[dsh-ops](https://github.com/T-Auto/dsh-ops)**, a separate bundle. Sage mode declares them
as an **optional dependency** (`optionalTools` in [`cordis.patch.yml`](cordis.patch.yml)):

- **dsh-ops installed** → those tools are adopted into the allow list and stay available.
- **dsh-ops absent** → the names are ignored and everything else keeps working. A missing
  optional provider is never an error.


To adopt a read-only tool from any other bundle, extend the map without touching the code:

```yaml
config:
  optionalTools:
    some-other-plugin: [their_read_tool]
```

### Also see

- [dsh-ops](https://github.com/T-Auto/dsh-ops) — the optional source of the `ops_*` tools.
- [Sage mode repository](https://github.com/zero360-TYN/dsh-sage-mode) — this plugin.

## Install

Open **Plugin Manager** in the Harness and enter this repository's URL as the install spec:

```
https://github.com/zero360-TYN/dsh-sage-mode
```
![pic_location: /readme_pic/install.png](/readme_pic/install.png)
The manager reads a GitHub repository URL as a git install spec, clones the package, adds its
`sage-mode` row, and activates it. Updating later means installing the same URL again; a fresh
JavaScript module generation needs an app restart to load.

<details>
<summary>Alternative: install from a local directory</summary>

From a checkout, point the manager at the absolute path instead:

```
plugin_manager(action: "install_bundle", target: "<absolute path to this repo>")
```

That installs the package as a **link**, so editing files in the repo affects the live plugin
directly — convenient while developing.

</details>

## Configuration

The row's defaults live in [`cordis.patch.yml`](cordis.patch.yml). Your own overrides belong
in the profile's user layer (`$DSH_HOME/profiles/<name>/cordis.patch.yml`). A patch replaces
the targeted row's **whole** `config`, so restate every key you want to keep:

```yaml
- id: sage-mode
  name: dsh-sage-mode
  config:
    command: sage          # command name (default: sage)
    sectionOrder: 3255     # prompt section placement
    allowedTools: [read, grep, web_search]   # keep only these
    optionalTools:         # optional deps: adopt their read-only tools when present
      dsh-ops: [ops_glob, ops_grep, ops_inspect_local_file]
    section: |             # the full advisory prompt
      ...
```

Unknown keys fail at load instead of being ignored, so a typo cannot silently disable your
configuration. Missing keys fall back to their defaults.

## How it works

- **State lives in the session log.** The mode folds the `command/run` + `command/done`
  pair the commands service already writes, so it adds **no custom event type** — an
  unknown event type would make older readers refuse to reopen the session. Resume and fork
  restore the mode automatically.
- **Enforced per agent.** `agent.ctx.tools.restrict({ allow })` hides the mutating tools and
  `agent.ctx.tools.guard()` denies anything that still reaches dispatch. Both disposers are
  owned by `agent.ctx` *and* kept in the plugin's own effect, so agent disposal and plugin
  unload both unwind them.
- **Zero `@deepseek-ai/*` dependencies.** A profile-installed bundle resolves those only from
  the dsh installation, so the plugin uses Node builtins plus services reached through `ctx`.
- The prompt section is registered on the agent's own scope and returns an empty string while
  the mode is off — no token cost when unused.

## Known limits

- Applies to the **current session only**; other tabs and sessions are unaffected.
- Under PTC mode the `run_code` transport itself is kept (otherwise the whole tool surface
  becomes unusable), but the generated SDK exposes only the permitted read-only tools.
- Plan mode's `exit_plan_mode` is hidden too; leave plan mode with `/plan off` or `/sage off`.
- Sandbox and approval policy are unaffected — this plugin governs **which tools the model
  holds**, not filesystem permissions.

## Test

```powershell
node test/self-test.mjs
```

Covers config validation, the session-log fold, the command contract, restriction/guard
registration and release, the fallback mask for unusual compositions, and admitting agents
that already existed when the plugin loaded.

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: Employed by Guaq AI for DeepSeek Harness: live job search on verified employer ATS boards
plugins.readme_text:
# Employed by Guaq AI for DeepSeek Harness

Live job search for [DeepSeek Harness](https://dsh-plugin.org) (dsh): search roles verified on about 5,000 employer applicant-tracking boards, open an employer's hiring profile, and brief a hiring market, from inside a dsh session.

This bundle mounts two things:

- the Employed skills (`skills/`), as an isolated skill provider;
- the remote Employed MCP server, `https://jobs.guaqai.me/mcp`, over Streamable HTTP.

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Guaq-AI/employed-dsh
```

Then, inside a session, store your API key (create one at <https://jobs.guaqai.me/profile>):

```text
/employed-login <api-key>
```

dsh's MCP client has no OAuth flow, so this bundle signs in with an API key kept in dsh's credential store. The key is never written to this package or to the session log, and it is sent only to `https://jobs.guaqai.me/mcp`.

## Details

- **Category:** Integrations & Connections.
- **Compatibility:** DeepSeek Harness with the `web` profile; the bundle is an ES module that exports `apply(ctx)` and uses dsh's own `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` and `@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem`. Any platform dsh runs on.
- **Permissions and external services:** one outbound connection, to `https://jobs.guaqai.me/mcp`, carrying the search filters the model chooses and your API key as a Bearer token. Account tools change only your own Employed data (profile, tracker, alerts), and only when you ask; nothing applies to jobs or contacts employers. No hooks, no shell commands, no files written.
- **Example prompts:** "Find entry-level backend roles in India." "Is Stripe hiring in London right now?"
- **Known limitations:** dsh's MCP client has no OAuth, so sign-in is by API key. Not yet run against a live dsh build; please open an issue if anything fails.

## Other agents

Claude Code, Codex, Copilot CLI, Cursor, Gemini CLI and the rest install from [Guaq-AI/employed-plugins](https://github.com/Guaq-AI/employed-plugins), which signs in with OAuth instead of an API key.

## About this repository

Generated from `plugins/` in the Employed source tree by `scripts/sync_public_repo.py`; edit there, not here. MIT licensed, see [LICENSE](LICENSE). Report security issues to support@guaqai.me.

plugins.description: AEMEATH Theme - sakura violet-rose theme plugin for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI
plugins.readme_text:
# 爱弥斯主题 · AEMEATH Theme

[English](README.en.md) | 中文

渐湖边暮色里的樱花瓣，带一点虚质空间的幽光——为 **DeepSeek Harness Web** 做的紫罗兰玫粉主题。

![主题效果](assets/aemath-poster.jpg)

- **全局换装**：浅色「樱花晨光」/ 深色「樱夜」两套配色，覆盖整套 `--dsw-*` 设计令牌，不是只换一个主色
- **主题色**：紫罗兰玫粉 `#963f86`（浅色）/ `#c96f9e`（深色），按钮、链接、选中态、滚动条、代码块全部联动
- **对话背景立绘**：立绘处理成淡彩后作为对话区背景层（全屏固定层 + 左侧遮罩淡出，不依赖任何带构建 hash 的组件类名）
- **Q 版徽章**：左下角圆形小头像，白圈 + 紫粉描边 + 柔光
- **favicon 与标题**：飞行雪绒·像素海豹 favicon，页面标题改为 `DeepSeek Harness - AEMEATH Theme`
- **零请求**：样式表、立绘、favicon 全部内联在插件里，不向外要任何资源

## 安装

主题是一个**客户端插件**（client plugin），装完刷新页面即可见效。

### 方式一：从插件市场

设置 → **插件市场** → 搜索 `aemath`（或「爱弥斯」）→ 一键安装 → 刷新页面。

### 方式二：命令行（`dsh web` 的 web profile）

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-theme-aemath
```

装完 **重启 `dsh web`**。

### 方式三：手动启用（装的是本地目录 / 压缩包时）

包已经在 profile 里、只是还没被加载时，往 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`
（`~\.dsh\profiles\web\cordis.patch.yml`）加一条 insert：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: ui-theme-aemath
      name: 'dsh-theme-aemath'
```

然后重启 `dsh web`。

> 桌面客户端（Electron）读的是 **`desktop` profile**，`dsh plugin` 按设计不碰它。
> 在桌面端要让 DSH 自己装：直接在会话里说「装一下 dsh-theme-aemath」。

### 关掉主题

三种都行，选一个：

```yaml
# ~\.dsh\profiles\web\cordis.patch.yml
- id: ui-theme-aemath
  disabled: true
```

或者把上面那条 insert 注释掉，或者在设置 → 插件里热禁用。重启 / 热重载后
主题消失，界面回到出厂配色——插件不会残留任何注入。

## 生效范围

主题覆盖的是 **配色令牌 + 两个装饰层**，不动任何组件结构：

| 覆盖的东西 | 怎么实现的 |
| --- | --- |
| 全部 `--dsw-*` 令牌 | `html body` 下重定义，浅深两套靠 `[data-ds-dark-theme]` 切换 |
| 对话区背景立绘 | `html body::before`，`z-index: 50`（在内容层之上、弹层之下），`pointer-events: none` |
| 左下角 Q 版徽章 | `html body::after`，`z-index: 999`，`pointer-events: none` |
| favicon / 页面标题 | 客户端插件在 `ctx.effect` 里换，卸载即还原 |

因为它只用到 `body` 上的伪元素和 CSS 变量，**前端升级换了构建 hash 也不会失效**——
这是刻意的：主题以前把图放进 dist，dsh 一升级就被还原，踩过一次。

## 微调

想改的话，直接改 `src/aemath-theme.css` 顶部的几个变量：

```css
--aemath-art-opacity: 0.42;   /* 背景立绘强度：越高越明显，也越"蒙" */
--aemath-chibi-size: 96px;    /* Q 版徽章尺寸 */
--aemath-chibi-left: 92px;    /* 徽章水平位置（侧边栏宽 - 尺寸）/ 2 */
--aemath-chibi-bottom: 170px; /* 徽章离底距离 */
```

改完重建：

```powershell
node scripts/build-client.mjs
```

重建是幂等的、可复现的：背景图按内容哈希 stamp 缓存标记，Q 版内联为 data URI，
favicon 内联为 SVG data URI。`lib/client.js` 是构建产物，别手改。

### 换立绘

1. 新的背景图存成 `assets/aemath-bg.jpg`（建议 1600px 宽、JPEG 质量 80 上下，
   主题会把它压到 `--aemath-art-opacity` 的透明度当水印用）
2. 新的 Q 版小图存成 `assets/aemath-chibi.jpg`（正方形，会被裁成圆形）
3. `node scripts/build-client.mjs`

> 本仓库内置的立绘为作者自有素材。**替换/二次分发前请确认你拥有所用图片的权利。**

## 项目结构

```
dsh-theme-aemath/
├── package.json            # dsh.client.platform = web
├── lib/                    # 发布产物（构建 + 手写）
│   ├── client.js           #   浏览器半边：内联整份样式表（构建产物）
│   └── index.js            #   host 半边：提供 /aemath-assets/* 素材路由
├── src/
│   ├── aemath-theme.css    # 主题源头：两套配色 + 背景层 + Q 版
│   └── client.template.js  # client 半边模板（__CSS__ / __SVG__ 占位）
├── scripts/
│   ├── build-client.mjs    # 零依赖构建脚本
│   ├── self-check.mjs      # 上架前自检（63 项）
│   └── make-poster.py      # 生成 assets/aemath-poster.jpg（需 Pillow）
├── assets/
│   ├── aemath-poster.jpg   # 市场/README 预览海报（合成图，非界面截图）
│   ├── aemath-bg.jpg       # 对话背景立绘（经淡彩处理）
│   ├── aemath-chibi.jpg    # Q 版徽章（构建期内联）
│   └── aemath-favicon.svg  # 像素海豹 favicon（构建期内联）
├── screenshots.json        # 市场截图清单
└── PUBLISHING.md           # 上架插件市场的完整步骤（不进 npm 包）
```

## 自检

改完东西、发布之前跑一次：

```powershell
node scripts/self-check.mjs
```

63 项检查：包清单（name / version / exports / `dsh.client.platform` / files 白名单）、
素材是不是真的 JPEG、`lib/client.js` 能不能被客户端加载器上下文执行、`apply()` 有没有
真的把样式表挂进 `document.head`、favicon 有没有换成功、host 路由对目录穿越和非法
方法返回什么、产物里有没有残留本机绝对路径。

## 上架

插件市场的条目来自 [awesome-dsh-plugin](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin)
精选列表（市场本身不维护清单）。从这台机器到上架要走的三步——npm 发布、
GitHub 仓库、提 PR——都写在 [PUBLISHING.md](PUBLISHING.md) 里，包含命令和坑。

## 素材路由

host 半边只做一件事：开一条 `/aemath-assets/*`。

- 只提供 `assets/` 里 **`aemath-` 前缀**的文件，目录成分一律丢掉——`..`、绝对路径、编码穿越都进不来
- 只接受 `GET` / `HEAD`
- 素材目录**相对模块自身**解析，不写死绝对路径，所以 `node_modules` 安装和 `link:.` 开发安装都能找到图
- 带 `?v=<内容哈希>`，换图立刻生效

## 许可

MIT。主题是非官方同人作品，与《鸣潮》/ 库洛游戏无关。

plugins.description: Order and disclosure for the DSH left sidebar driven by what is actually running: a workspace floats to the top when one of its sessions starts and keeps that place when it finishes, an idle workspace folds only after a short grace period. Six switches, each reversible.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-sidebar-focus

左侧工作区的排序与展开：按「有没有在跑」**和**「你正在哪儿」决定。六条规则，每条一个开关，位置在
**插件页 → 点开 `dsh-sidebar-focus` 之后的详情页**里（在描述与行列表之间）。

## 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-sidebar-focus
```

还没上 npm 时用 GitHub 源：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:wjingshan/dsh-sidebar-focus
```

装完**刷新页面**即可 —— 本插件是纯客户端（宿主半身是空的），不需要重启 `dsh web`。

## 它做什么

| 设置 | 默认 | 作用 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 置顶最近有活动的工作区 | 开 | 有会话跑过的工作区排到最前，按**最近一次活动**排序。跑完**不会掉回原位**，只有更新的活动才把它往下挤一位。**只影响显示**，你手动拖出来的工作区顺序从不被改写 |
| 置顶当前会话所在的工作区 | 开 | 你正在用的那个会话（**包括刚新建、还没开始跑的**）所在的工作区也排到最前。新建的会话不渲染状态点，只靠上面那条永远浮不上来 |
| 自动展开正在运行的工作区 | 开 | 有会话在跑、或正在等你的工作区自动展开。宿主本身只在「当前会话所在的工作区」上这么做，这条把它扩展到所有在跑的工作区 |
| 置顶正在进行的会话 | 开 | 运行中与等待你处理的会话排到所属工作区的最前 |
| 收起没有运行的工作区 | 开 | 没有会话在跑的工作区保持折叠；**刚跑完的会先留 2.5 秒再收**（宿主分两步报告「跑完了」：先清 `running`、之后才升起完成提醒） |
| 保留未读完成提醒 | 开 | 含「已完成未查看」的工作区不自动折叠，避免刚跑完的会话被收起来 |
| 只保留最近活跃的工作区展开 | **2** | 最近有会话跑过的前 N 个工作区**一直展开**，其余空闲的在宽限期后收起。用 `−` / `+` 调整，范围 0–20，`0` = 关掉这条 |


## 交互语义：什么时候它不接管

自动折叠最烦人的失败模式是「你点开、它立刻折回去」。所以两侧都留了 **意图豁免**：

- 你**亲手展开**一个空闲工作区 → 它保持展开，插件不再碰它，直到这个工作区重新变忙再变闲；
- 你**亲手折叠**一个正在运行的工作区 → 它保持折叠，插件不替你展开，同样直到忙碌状态再次变化。

豁免只在**本次页面会话内**有效，刷新后回到规则本身。判断依据是 `aria-expanded` 上不是本插件
写出的翻转——所以「搜索结果跳转」「新建会话」这类宿主自己的展开，也被当成你的意图而保留。

另外两条不参与自动折叠的例外：

- **未分组（Ungrouped）永不折叠**：那是散落会话的收容所，不是谁主动选的工作区；
- **当前选中会话所在的工作区保持展开**：否则切换会话会落到一个被折起来的组上
  （宿主的自动展开只对「没有存过状态」的组生效，而本插件会写状态）。

## 做法，以及为什么

- **排序不移动 DOM**：列表列原本是 `overflow-y:auto` 的块容器，`order` 对它无效；插件先把它变成
  flex 列（`[data-wsf-rank-tree]`），再用 `order` 给忙碌工作区 / 活动会话排名。DOM 节点从不移动，
  所以 React 的 reconciliation 与内置的 FLIP 行动画都不受影响。
  - `order` 作用在 **flex item** 上，而每一行外面还套着 `HoverCard` 的 `<span>`，所以排名规则用
    `:has()` 同时匹配「被包一层」与「裸行」两种形状；JS 侧同样**不能假设 `parentElement`**，
    分组位置一律由 `sectionOf()` 向上解析。
  - 排序是**纯展示**：不写 `Workspace.sessionIds`，也不碰你手动排序的结果。
- **「浮到顶部」有两个互相独立的理由**：工作区**忙**（行状态点 ∪ 状态快照），或者它**装着你当前选中的
  会话**。后者专门为 blank 的新会话而加：宿主的 `SessionNodeItem` 把状态槽写成 `!row.blank && …`，
  一个刚建、还没发消息的会话**一个状态点都不渲染**（`data-state` 根本不存在），状态快照里也还没有它，
  所以「忙」这条路**永远看不见它**；而 `aria-selected="true"` 对 blank 行同样成立，正好补上这个缺口。
  两条理由分别由 `pinBusyWorkspaces` 与 `pinCurrentWorkspace` 掌管，关掉一条不会影响另一条。
- **名次是锁存的，不是实时读数**：只有工作区**从「不活跃」变成「活跃」的那一刻**才记时间戳，活跃期间
  不再刷新；排名写成**内联 `order`**（每条工作区的名次都不同，静态 CSS 表达不了），从未活动过的工作区
  不带 `order`，保持原生顺序排在后面。于是**跑完不掉位**，只有更新的活动才把它往下挤一位。
- **排序分两段，运行中的永远在前**：第 1 段是**正在跑 / 正在等你**的工作区（段内按最近活动倒序），
  第 2 段是其它曾经活跃过的工作区（同样按最近活动倒序）。所以「跑了很久但还在跑」不会被「刚活动完
  又闲下来」的挤到后面 —— 锁存只决定**同一段内**的相对顺序，不跨越段。
- **折叠要等连续空闲 2.5 秒**：宿主分两步报告「跑完了」（先清 `running`，之后才升起
  `completionUnread`），在第一帧「看起来空闲」时就折，会关掉一个刚出结果、提醒还没到的工作区。
  两个配套细节：宽限期到点时若没有任何 DOM 变化，是**没有人来叫醒扫描**的（用 `wakeIn()` 定时器补）；
  新活动挣到的名次是在扫描**过程中**发现的，而 `ranking` 算在扫描**开头**（用 `rankDirty` 补一次扫描）。
- **「最近几个保持展开」和「排序」共用同一个次序**：折叠判定里读的就是 `ranking`（`lastActive` 排名），
  所以**列表最上面那 N 个就是保持展开的那 N 个**，不会出现「浮在最上面却折着」的矛盾。把它设成 `0`
  时判定退化成原来的「空闲 + 宽限期就折」。正在运行的工作区本来就因为 `blocking` 不会被折，与排名无关。
- **折叠是一次状态写入**：折叠的组根本不渲染会话行（宿主的 `deriveGroups` 对折叠组返回空
  `sessions`），所以 DOM 层做不到，必须改展开状态本身。写入走宿主自己的视图 store：
  `ctx.get('uiWorkspace').view.setGroupExpanded(key, expanded)`，键就是工作区 id。
- **「有没有在跑」不能只读行**：只看 DOM 的判据在这里必然出错——组一折起来就没有行可读，于是
  「里面有会话开始跑了」永远看不见，那个工作区会一直关着（用户报过：正在运行的工作区被折叠，打不开）。
  忙碌判定因此改为读 **Session 状态快照** `useSessionStatus`（`running` / `pendingInteraction` /
  `completionUnread`，与三条判据一一对应）加 **Workspace 成员表** `useWorkspaces`
  （`items[].sessionIds` 说明哪些会话属于哪个工作区）。这两个事实与「有没有渲染成一行」无关，
  折叠态照样成立，所以折叠中的工作区一旦开工就会被看见并展开。
  两个 hook 由挂在 `shell.overlay` 上的**零渲染桥接组件**发布给 watcher（选它只因为那个席位永远挂载）。
  行仍然照读——行级标记要用，快照未就绪时也要回退；两个来源取**并集**，任一见到在跑就不许关。
- **所有开关都是开关**：关闭时对应的 `data-wsf-*` 标记会被移除，CSS 规则随之失效，侧栏回到原生
  布局与原生折叠行为——不做「半开」状态。

### 依赖的宿主契约（实测于本 profile 的内置 `dsh-client-ui-workspace`）

| 事实 | 来源 |
| --- | --- |
| 会话列表是 `div[role="tree"]` | `AnimatedRows.render` |
| 工作区行是 `div[data-row-key="workspace:<key>"][role="treeitem"][aria-expanded]` | `ProjectRowItem` |
| **每一行都被 `HoverCard` 套了一层 `<span>`**，所以行的 `parentElement` **不是**分组容器；分组要向上找（父元素是列表列本身，或父元素是 `role="group"` 容器）。未分组是唯一例外——宿主对它直接返回裸行 | `ProjectRowItem` / `HoverCard` |
| 会话行是 `div[data-row-key="session:<id>"][role="treeitem"][aria-selected]`，**第一个子元素**是该行自己的状态槽（同样被 `HoverCard` 包着，所以 `:scope >` 读不到它） | `SessionNodeItem` |
| 状态点带 `data-state` ∈ {`ongoing`, `warning`, `done`, `error`, `idle`} | `ui-primitives` 的 `StateDot` |
| 展开状态存在 `dsh.workspace.view.v5`，`groupExpansion[key]` 显式为 `false` 才折叠 | `createWorkspaceViewStore` / `deriveGroups` |
| 接口是 `ctx.get('uiWorkspace').view.setGroupExpanded(key, expanded)` | `UiWorkspaceService` 的 `view` 字段 |
| 折叠的组**不渲染任何会话行**，所以运行状态必须另有来源 | `deriveGroups` 的 `GroupNode.sessions` |
| 槽位标准钩子 `useSessionStatus` / `useWorkspaces` 提供状态快照与工作区成员 | `shell.overlay` 的 standardProps |
| `WorkspaceSnapshot.items[].sessionIds` 是「谁属于哪个工作区」 | `dsh-api-workspace-controller` 的 `WorkspaceView` / `WorkspaceSnapshot` |

这些是构建产物的结构，不是文档化 API：宿主升级后**如果**结构变了，插件会安静地什么都不做
（`data-wsf-*` 标记无处可落），而不是弄坏侧栏。若 `uiWorkspace.view.setGroupExpanded` 不存在，
折叠会被整体关闭，并在**该插件的详情页**上显示告警、控制台打印原因——不会静默失败。

## 已知限制

- **不折叠未分组**，理由见上；如果你要连它一起收，改 `scanGroup` 里的 `key === ''` 判断。
- **自动折叠写的是宿主自己的视图偏好**：被自动折起来的工作区，其 `groupExpansion[key]` 会以
  `false` 持久化。卸载本插件后它们会保持折叠——手动点开即可恢复，或在插件页里禁用这个包再刷新。
- **子工作区（树形分组）不参与置顶**：子组在父组的 `role="group"` 容器里，不是列表列的直接子元素，
  `order` 在那里无效。会话级排序不受影响。
- 状态判定只读「运行中 `ongoing`」与「等待你 `warning`」；`error` 不参与。

## 验证状态

已验证：

- `node --check` 通过；manifest 解析通过；
- 安装返回 `application: applied`，profile 的 `dependencies` 与 `dsh.profile.bundles` 都已登记；
- **实时**客户端注册已生效：`plugins.bundle.config` 席位上出现了 `dsh-sidebar-focus` 这个 key
  （`cordis_inspect_query` 可见）。插件页只在**存在该 key 的注册**时才渲染那块配置
  （owner 的判据是 `ledger.bundles.has(pkg.name)`），所以这一条同时证明详情页里会出现这 6 个开关 + 1 个计数器；
- 原先在「设置 → 通用」的 5 行已确认从 `settings.general.item` 移除，不会两处重复；
- 状态桥接已确认挂载：`shell.overlay` 的实时占用者里有 `dsh-sidebar-focus.status-bridge`，
  而该席位的 standardProps 同时提供 `useSessionStatus` 与 `useWorkspaces`。

**真实 GUI 实测确认（2026-10-17，用户实际操作）**：

- 新建会话的工作区浮到顶部；
- 会话跑完**不掉回原位**，只有更新的活动才把它挤下去一位；
- 另一个工作区开跑时，那个顶上来、原来的顺延；
- 跑完的工作区**不会立刻收起**；
- 「只保留最近 N 个展开」及其 `− / +` 计数器工作正常。

包括 0.1.1 那个根因修复（`sectionOf()` 的三种形状 + CSS `:has()`）在内，这些行为此前只是从宿主源码
推演出来的，现在有了真实页面上的确认。

仍未验证（没有可读的 DOM 通道；按插件规范的验证边界，未用截图或模拟 DOM 冒充）：

- 视觉细节：flex 化后的行高与间距、浅色/深色两套主题下的观感；
- 与内置 FLIP 行动画、拖拽排序的共存表现；
- **子工作区（树形分组）的排序**：`order` 对子组无效，这是已声明的限制；
- 在**已折叠**的工作区里启动会话、它应当自动展开这一条，没有被单独复现过（依赖状态快照路径）。

自查方式：刷新 Web 页面 → 打开一个正在跑的工作区（应自动展开并置顶）→ 打开一个空闲工作区
（应保持折叠，你手动展开后应保持展开）→ 控制台不应出现 `[dsh-sidebar-focus]` 开头的报错。

plugins.description: A Keyboard Shortcuts settings page for DeepSeek Harness (DSH), with permission-mode cycling, reasoning-effort stepping, prompt navigation, a status-page shortcut, a task-list toggle, and an optional composer key remap.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-keyboard-shortcut

A Keyboard Shortcuts settings page for DeepSeek Harness (DSH), with permission-mode
cycling, reasoning-effort stepping, prompt navigation, a status-page shortcut, a
task-list toggle, and an optional composer key remap.

[中文文档](README.zh-CN.md)

## Overview

`dsh-keyboard-shortcut` adds one page to DSH's Settings panel and eight shortcuts
to the application. The page lists every binding in the running application,
lets you change the ones this plugin owns, and carries a switch for remapping the
composer's Enter keys.

Every shortcut this plugin adds is an ordinary DSH command. It appears in the
shortcut reference, it can be rebound, and it respects the same conflict rules as
the built-in commands.

## Requirements

| Requirement | Minimum |
|---|---|
| DeepSeek Harness | `0.2.0-rc.2` |
| Node.js (for building from source) | `22.12.0` |

This plugin is a **client plugin**: everything it does happens in the browser
half. Its Host half is an empty `apply` that exists only so DSH serves the
browser bundle.

## Install

Install into a profile with the DSH plugin command:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-keyboard-shortcut
```

Then restart the profile, or toggle the bundle off and on from **Settings →
Plugins** if the profile reloads live.

## What you get

### A Keyboard Shortcuts settings page

**Settings → Keyboard shortcuts** sits directly after General. It has four
sections:

- **Plugin shortcuts** — the commands this plugin owns, each row editable. Click
  a row, press a combination, and it saves. Press Escape to cancel.
- **Input navigation** — the two page-key shortcuts. These have no command id,
  so they are listed read-only rather than being rebindable; the reason is under
  [Known limitations](#known-limitations).
- **Input optimisation** — the composer key switch described below.
- **Application shortcuts** — every other registered command, read-only. This is
  the table that makes a binding conflict comprehensible: when a combination is
  refused, the row that already owns it is visible right there.

### Shortcuts

| Shortcut | Action | Platforms |
|---|---|---|
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Q</kbd> | Cycle to the next permission mode | Desktop Windows, macOS |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>1</kbd> | Lower the reasoning effort one level | Desktop |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>2</kbd> | Raise the reasoning effort one level | Desktop |
| <kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>A</kbd> | Open the DeepSeek status page in the sidebar browser | Desktop |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>L</kbd> | Expand or collapse the task list | Desktop |
| <kbd>PgUp</kbd> | Go to the previous input | All (fixed) |
| <kbd>PgDn</kbd> | Go to the next input | All (fixed) |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>/</kbd> | Open this plugin's settings page | All |

<kbd>Ctrl</kbd>/<kbd>Cmd</kbd>+<kbd>/</kbd> is the built-in shortcut reference's
default binding. This plugin claims it through the shortcut preference layer, so
the reference dialog moves off that key and stays reachable from **Settings →
General → Edit shortcuts**. Turning the switch off restores the original
binding.

### Input optimisation

When enabled, the composer's three Enter gestures rotate:

| Stroke | Default | With input optimisation |
|---|---|---|
| <kbd>Enter</kbd> | Send | Insert a line break |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Enter</kbd> | Complementary Queue/Steer | Send |
| <kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>Enter</kbd> | Insert a line break | Complementary Queue/Steer |

The switch is off by default.

## Configuration

The plugin reads two preferences from browser storage. Both are off-by-default
except the shortcut takeover, and both are per device.

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `optimizeComposerKeys` | `false` | Rotate the composer's Enter gestures |
| `takeOverShortcutKey` | `true` | Give <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>/</kbd> to this plugin |

Preferences live in `localStorage` under `dsh.keyboard-shortcut.v1`, beside the
key bindings DSH itself stores per device. They are not in the Host settings
document, so one machine's choice cannot rewrite another's.

Changing a binding through the settings page writes to the same store DSH's own
shortcut editor uses: `localStorage` on Web, and `userData/keybindings.json`
under Electron.

## Permissions

The plugin requests no elevated permissions. It reads the session projections
DSH already publishes to the browser and runs the same `/permission` command the
built-in picker runs. It performs no filesystem access and no network requests.

## Known limitations

- **Cycle, effort, status-page and task-list shortcuts are Desktop-only by
  default.** DSH reserves <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Q</kbd> outside Desktop Windows
  and macOS, and browsers claim <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>1</kbd>…<kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>8</kbd>
  for tab switching. <kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>A</kbd> and <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>L</kbd>
  are not admitted by the browser allowlist at all — a single non-primary
  modifier is refused, and both keys are spoken for. All five commands exist on
  every platform and can be bound by hand; they simply ship unbound where the
  combination cannot work.
- **The status-page shortcut reuses an open page.** The sidebar browser
  registers itself as a tab type that may appear more than once, so opening it
  through the sidebar's own API always mints a new tab. The plugin therefore
  looks for an existing browser tab first and reveals it, expanding the column
  if it is collapsed. A tab belonging to another session is ignored, because the
  sidebar only reveals tabs in the session on screen.
- **The task-list toggle clicks the panel header.** DSH keeps the collapsed
  state inside the panel component and exposes no handle, so the shortcut drives
  the same button a click would. A session with no task list shows nothing to
  toggle, which the shortcut reports instead of failing.
- **Prompt navigation drives the turn rail.** DSH publishes no service for
  jumping to a turn, so the shortcut activates the rail's own marks. A turn is
  anchored at its first user message, so "previous input" means "previous turn".
- **The page keys cannot be registered, so they are read raw.**
  <kbd>PgUp</kbd>/<kbd>PgDn</kbd> are handled through `observeFixedInput`
  rather than `registerFixed`, because DSH's shortcut registry validates every
  declared code against a closed whitelist — `Key*`, `Digit*`, `F1`–`F24`, and a
  fixed set of named keys that does **not** include the page keys.
  `registerFixed` normalizes its bindings up front and throws
  `Unsupported shortcut code: PageUp`, so a registration could never succeed.
  The keyboard layer forwards every keydown to `observeFixedInput` regardless of
  registration, so the keys work; they just have no catalog row, and the settings
  page lists them from a local table as non-rebindable rows.
- **The composer remap is a DOM-layer integration.** The composer's keymap is
  private to `dsh-client-ui-conversation`; the option rewrites an event's
  modifier flags rather than reimplementing the send logic. See
  [docs/design.md](docs/design.md) for the reasoning and the failure mode.
- **The settings navigation glyph is a DOM patch.** DSH chooses navigation icons
  with a hardcoded switch on the section id and offers no icon field on the
  registration, so the glyph is applied with a CSS mask.
- **Recording loses React state.** Rebinding re-registers the command and
  re-renders the page, like any catalog change.

## Development

```sh
npm install
npm run build      # writes lib/index.js and lib/client.js
npm test           # build check + unit tests
npm run watch      # rebuild the client half on change
```

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) and
[docs/development.md](docs/development.md).

## Documentation

- [docs/design.md](docs/design.md) — architecture and the decisions behind it
- [docs/shortcuts.md](docs/shortcuts.md) — every binding, its owner, and its
  failure modes
- [docs/development.md](docs/development.md) — building, testing, releasing

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: 把本机已登录的 Cursor 模型接入 DeepSeek Harness：原生 LlmAdapter 直连 agent.v1.AgentService/Run 双向流
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-connect-cursor

把本机已登录的 Cursor 桌面应用的模型接入 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（`dsh`），在 dsh 的模型选择器里直接使用 Cursor 账号能调用的模型。

> 非官方。逆向自 Cursor 的 `agent.v1.AgentService/Run` 私有协议（ConnectRPC + Protobuf + HTTP/2 双向流），与 Cursor（Ansysphere）、DeepSeek 均无关联。仅供个人学习研究。

## 工作原理

- 读 Cursor 桌面应用的登录态（`state.vscdb` 里的 JWT），不启动额外 OAuth
- 通过 HTTP/2 双向流调用 `agent.v1.AgentService/Run`，用原生 `LlmAdapter` 把 Cursor 的流式增量翻成 dsh 的 `StreamChunk`（不走 loopback 代理）
- 模型目录通过 `AvailableModels` unary 调用实时拉取

## 凭据来源（按优先级）

1. `CURSOR_ACCESS_TOKEN` 环境变量
2. 桌面应用 `state.vscdb`（SQLite，需 Node 22.5+ 内置 `node:sqlite`）
3. CLI 的 `auth.json`（macOS/Linux `~/.config/cursor/`，Windows `%APPDATA%\Cursor\`）
4. `CURSOR_API_KEY`（`crsr_` 开头，换取短期 token）

均为只读，不写入桌面应用文件。JWT 约 1 小时有效，由运行中的桌面应用刷新；过期时重新打开 Cursor 即可。

## 已知限制

- 协议私有、版本门控：`x-cursor-client-version` 过期会被上游以误导性限流错误拒绝，用 `CURSOR_CLI_VERSION` 跟一个真实 CLI 版本号
- `model_details.model_id` 必须是默认 variant 的 slug（如 `claude-sonnet-5-thinking-high`），基础 id 会被拒为 `ERROR_BAD_MODEL_NAME`
- `UserMessageAction` 必须带 `request_context`（缺了服务端只发心跳不产出）
- `lib/schema.js` 从 Cursor 自带的 `workbench.desktop.main.js` 提取 protobuf schema（约 800 个类型），供 Cursor 升级后重新核对字段号；编码本身不依赖它
- token 用量统计：Cursor 不总发 `turn_ended`，`usage` 可能为空

## 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:greatyao/dsh-connect-cursor
```

安装后重启 dsh，模型选择器出现 `cursor` 分组。

## 开发

```sh
node --test test/*.test.js   # 46 个单测
```

## 平台支持

macOS / Windows / Linux。插件按平台探测 Cursor 桌面应用的安装位置：

- macOS：`/Applications/Cursor.app/Contents/Resources/app`
- Windows：`%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\cursor\resources\app`
- Linux：`/usr/share/cursor/resources/app`、`/opt/Cursor/resources/app`

非默认安装位置用 `CURSOR_APP_PATH` 指向应用根目录，或用 `CURSOR_WORKBENCH_BUNDLE` 直接指向 `workbench.desktop.main.js`。

凭据按平台读取：macOS `~/Library/Application Support/Cursor/User/globalStorage/state.vscdb`、Windows `%APPDATA%\Cursor\User\globalStorage\state.vscdb`、Linux `~/.config/Cursor/User/globalStorage/state.vscdb`。需 Node 22.5+（内置 `node:sqlite`）。

Windows 上未实测；如遇问题请提 issue。

## 免责声明

仅供个人学习研究使用。使用者需遵守 Cursor 的服务条款，因使用本项目产生的后果由使用者自行承担。

## 许可证

MIT

plugins.readme_text: # @deepwhale-cn/dsh-algorithm-filing [![dshfind 收录](https://dshfind.com/api/badge/feely0208/dsh-algorithm-filing?lang=zh)](https://dshfind.com/zh/plugins/feely0208/dsh-algorithm-filing) **算法备案与告知** —— 查算法推荐服务有没有**关闭选项**、告知、备案。 ## 不装它会怎样 你的 App 有「猜你喜欢」，代码大概是这样： ```js async function recommend(userId) { const tags = await getUserTags(userId); return await rankByTags(tags); } ``` **功能正常，但漏了一条硬要求：** > **《互联网信息服务算法推荐管理规定》第十七条** > plugins.description: QQ 通道一体化插件：出站沉默守卫、每轮行为规则、对话节奏（入站合并/出站分段）、人设（情绪+主动发言+风格学习）、语音（qq_say: 文字→edge-tts→语音消息）。Runtime prototype patching for dsh-onebot-qq — upgrade-proof, no node_modules edits.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-onebot-companion

> 一个插件，把 QQ 通道该有的都装回来：**出站沉默守卫 + 每轮行为规则 + 对话节奏 + 人设 + 语音 + 会话换代防护 + 时间戳**。
>
> 中文 · [English](./README.en.md)

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](./LICENSE)
[![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D22-brightgreen.svg)](https://nodejs.org)

**DSH 插件** · 为 [`dsh-onebot-qq`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-onebot-qq) 补上被 0.9.0 升级冲掉的能力。

**同系列**：[dsh-hot-reloader](https://github.com/xfgil/dsh-hot-reloader)（热重载）·
[dsh-session-clock](https://github.com/xfgil/dsh-session-clock)（会话时钟）·
[dsh-proxy-on-demand](https://github.com/xfgil/dsh-proxy-on-demand)（按需代理） · [dsh-second-opinion](https://github.com/xfgil/dsh-second-opinion)（第二意见）

> **本仓库取代** `dsh-onebot-guard` / `dsh-onebot-prompt` / `dsh-onebot-rhythm` 三个独立插件
> （它们的能力已全部并入本插件的模块）。已装过旧插件的请先卸载再装这个，**不要同时装**——
> 两套代码会各自包装同一条原型链，导致重复分条、重复计数。

---

## 目录

- [为什么需要它](#为什么需要它)
- [它做什么](#它做什么)
- [环境要求](#环境要求)
- [安装](#安装)
- [配置](#配置)
- [HTTP 观测面](#http-观测面)
- [工作原理](#工作原理)
- [已知边界](#已知边界)
- [License](#license)

---

## 为什么需要它

`dsh-onebot-qq` 只负责把 QQ 通道接上，聊天本身该有的东西它不管：沉默怎么表达、括号里的
旁白算不算话、一条长回复要不要分几次发、对方连打三行算几个回合、她此刻什么心情、
要不要主动开口、消息之间隔了多久。这些都得由外面补上 —— 本插件补的就是这一整套：

| 能力 | 现状 |
| --- | --- |
| 沉默协议（`[[silent]]`） | 由 `guard` 拦下 |
| 括号旁白剥离 | 由 `guard` 剥掉 |
| 出站分段（一条长回复分几次发） | 由 `rhythm` 完成 |
| 入站合并（连打三行算一个回合） | 由 `rhythm` 完成 |
| 情绪 / 主动发言 / 风格学习 | 由 `persona` 提供 |
| 14 条行为规则 | 由 `prompt` 每轮注入 |
| QQ 分享卡片的标题与链接 | `linkcard` 模块（上游只留一个 `[卡片]`） |
| 会话换代防护 | `adopt` 模块 |
| 时间戳与间隔（`time=`/`gap=`） | `stamp` 模块 |
| 群里喊名字也算被叫到 | `mention` 模块 |
| 群里聊到兴趣时插一句 | `mention` 模块的 `topics` |
| 群友回合禁用工具（硬隔离） | `isolation` 模块（`ctx.tools.guard()`） |
| 她自己的小本子（三档遗忘） | `diary` 模块 + `qq_diary` 工具 |
| 答应过的事到点想起来 | `promise` 模块 + `qq_promise` 工具 |
| 关系阶段（不只是个数字） | `tier` 模块（把 `affinity` 投影成台阶） |
| 「她最后一次开口是什么时候」 | `lastword` 模块 + `/physical` 体检表 |

**为什么不手改 `node_modules`**：把那批约定直接写进 `node_modules` 里，`dsh-onebot-qq`
一升级（pnpm 换目录）就会整个被冲掉，同样的坑会再踩一遍。所以本插件一行都不改
`node_modules`，只从外面给原型挂包装 —— 升级不会再把功能冲掉。

### 为什么是一个插件而不是四个

这四个能力最初被拆成 `guard` / `prompt` / `rhythm` / `persona` 四个独立包。合并的理由很实在：

- 四份代码里重复的东西太多 —— `resolveProfileDirs()`（探测 profile 目录）逐字重复两份、
  `patchMethod()` 两份、HTTP 观测面三份、loopback 判定三份、状态落盘两份。
- 四个包各自 `import()` 同一个 `dsh-onebot-qq`，各自起一个 3 秒扫描定时器，各自维护一份统计。
- 用户只装一个、只配一块，比装四个再对着四份文档调参好得多。

合并后：**一个包、一份配置、一个 HTTP 面**，内部按职责分成十七个模块，各自可独立开关。

## 它做什么

| 模块 | 干什么 | 挂在哪 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `guard` | 出站闸：拦 `[[silent]]`、剥整行括号旁白、吞「⏳ 排队提示」「该命令仅管理员可用。」与**自述/报幕**（「我在等他回话」「我已经发了一句过去」这类回合进度，2026-10-19 加）；整条为空就不发 | `OutboundPipeline.prototype.sendToChat` / `sendMsg` |
| `adopt` | 会话换代防护：裸 id 还有磁盘日志时**接管**（resume）而不是把它永久退休、另开一个新会话 | `ChatRegistry.prototype.createChat` |
| `stamp` | 给注入边界补回 `time="..."`（本条消息的时刻）与 `gap="..."`（距上一条的间隔，如 `3m47s`），让模型不必自己做时间戳减法 | `ChatBridge.prototype.handleInbound`（记账）+ `ChatBridge.prototype.dispatchFollowup`（注入） |
| `prompt` | 每轮注入 14 条行为规则 + 情绪行 + 风格行 | 宿主 `agent/pre-step`（不挂原型） |
| `rhythm` | 入站合并（连打三行 = 一个回合）+ 出站分段（一条长回复分几次发） | `ChatBridge.prototype.dispatchFollowup` / `sendToChat` |
| `persona` | 情绪四变量 + 随机主动发言 + 风格学习 | `ChatBridge.prototype.handleInbound` / `onSessionEvent` |
| `mention` | 群里喊她名字算被叫到（`diving` 潜水续话）+ 聊到她感兴趣的方向时插一句（`topics`） | `InboundPipeline.prototype.processInbound` |
| `isolation` | 群聊里非管理员回合禁用一切工具（只留发声 + 白名单内的 `read_image` + 本轮聊天里出现过的链接） | 宿主 `ctx.tools.guard()`（不挂原型） |
| `linkcard` | 把 QQ 分享卡片的正文与跳转链接捞回来：`[卡片]` → `[卡片:标题 https://…]`（直链优先 `qqdocurl`，否则 `jumpUrl`） | `InboundPipeline.prototype.processInbound` |
| `emoji` | 把上游翻错的 emoji 换成 `[表情:名字]`；把被丢弃的商城表情包补成可读图片；认不出的原生表情整条不回 | `InboundPipeline.prototype.processInbound` |
| `sleep` | 睡意闸：说了「去睡/晚安」之后，群里**只有被 @ 或喊名字才接**，私聊照旧 | `InboundPipeline.prototype.processInbound`（优先级 30，在 mention 外层） |
| `hands` | 「社交的手」：`qq_poke`（戳一戳）/ `qq_react`（贴表情回应）/ `qq_like`（名片赞）/ `qq_requests`（查申请）；`qq_approve` **不直接生效**，生成审批单发管理员私聊，等他回 `/同意 编号` | `InboundPipeline.prototype.processInbound`（拦管理员的审批命令） |
| `voice` | `qq_say` 工具：文字 → 合成（edge-tts 云端 / 本机 IndexTTS）→ 作为 QQ 语音发出 | 只注册工具，不挂原型 |
| `lastword` | 记一笔「她最后一次真正开口是什么时候」，含原文片段与累计条数。不改参数、不抛错 | `OutboundPipeline.prototype.sendToChat` / `sendMsg` |

十七个模块中有十一个挂在原型上，且**存在共享挂载点**（`dispatchFollowup` 上是 stamp + rhythm，
`handleInbound` 上是 stamp + persona，`processInbound` 上是 sleep + mention + emoji + linkcard + hands）。它们靠 `core/patch.js`
的模块身份标记共存、互不吞并，链上的先后由模块**优先级**唯一决定，与挂载时序无关。

> `sleep` 的优先级是 **30**（高于 `stamp` 的 20），必须排在 `mention` **外层**：
> `mention` 会给「没 @ 但叫了名字」的消息补一个假 at 段，如果 `sleep` 在内层，
> 那道闸看到的就已经是「被 @ 了」，永远拦不住。

### `adopt` 修的是什么

`dsh-onebot-qq` 原生的 `createChat` 里有这么一段：

```js
let sessionId = makeSessionId(sessionIdForChat(chatId));
if (this.isSessionIdBlocked(sessionId)) {
    sessionId = this.freshSessionId(chatId);
}
else if (await this.hasPersistedLog(sessionId)) {
    this.retireSession(sessionId);          // ← 永久退休，写进 retired-sessions.json
    sessionId = this.freshSessionId(chatId);
}
```

裸 id（如 `onebot-group-535746440`）在磁盘上**还有历史日志**时，它不接管，而是把裸 id
**永久退休**、换一个带时间戳后缀的新 id。`retireSession` 是永久的，此后每次 `createChat`
都从第一个分支掉进 `freshSessionId` —— 表现就是**每条消息开一个新会话**，上下文全丢。

关键区别：**只有 `agents.create()` 会和已存在的日志撞车；`agents.resume()` 正是「接管这份
日志」的那个调用。** 所以本模块从外面包住 `createChat`，在进入原方法之前先做决定。
三种情况**明确放行**给原方法：① `evictedChats` 里有这个 chat（快照 id 比裸 id 更权威）
② 裸 id 已被退休（尊重记录）③ 裸 id 没有持久化日志（没有可接管的）。

会话 id 的推导**直接用上游自己的 `chat.js#sessionIdForChat`**，不在本模块里复刻那个
正则 —— 抄一份就等于埋「上游改了规则而我们还按老规则算 id」的坑，算错 id 的后果是
「采纳一个不存在的会话」，比不采纳更糟。拿不到该函数时**直接放弃挂载**，不退化成猜。

### `stamp` 修的是什么

上游的 `<user_message ...>` 边界上**一点时间信息都没有**。`lib/chat.js` 两个构造器都是
3 参，签名里没有时刻：

```js
export function wrapUserMessage(content, userId, nickname) { … }            // lib/chat.js:133
export function buildGroupMessagePrefix(nickname, userId, mentioned) { … }  // lib/chat.js:109
```

`lib/inbound.js` 的 `normalizeOneBot11(event)` 返回的对象里同样没有 time 字段 —— 它把
`event.time` 丢掉了。所以模型看到的每条消息都是「刚才」，两个时间戳都没有。

**为什么需要**：模型**不会可靠地做两个时间戳的减法**，很容易把「隔了两小时」说成
「过了一整天」。这正是加这两个属性的全部动机 —— 把已经算好的间隔直接递过去，等于把
那道算术从模型手里拿走，让它**没有算术可做错**。

本模块往开标签上补回两个属性：

- `time="2026-10-08T15:15:23+08:00"` —— 对方**按下发送**的时刻（本地时区、带秒；
  保留秒是为了同一分钟内的两条也能排序、能被可靠相减）。
- `gap="3m47s"` —— 距他上一条消息隔了多久，**已经算好**。写法是紧凑、**不含空格**、
  最多两个最高整单位的时长：`47s` / `3m47s` / `15h35m` / `2d4h`。不含空格是为了原样
  穿过下面那道字符白名单，短到一眼能读完。

**首次没有基线时 `gap` 留空，不猜** —— 省略属性好过印一个模型会当真的间隔。跨宿主重启的
「上一条入站时刻」因此要落盘（`stamp-state.json`，与 `mood-state.json` / `style-state.json`
同目录同范式，debounce 3 秒原子替换）。不落盘的话，重启后基线就是空的，第一条只能省略
gap，模型随即去读周期旁白里的 Elapsed 行，又把「两小时」说成「过了一整天」。
基线表**最多 500 个 chat**（沿用同一套 `MAX_CHATS`），超出时按「最久没来消息」淘汰 ——
没有这道闸，那张表会随这辈子收过消息的 chat 数单调增长。

**字符白名单**：两个值都用正则洗过 —— 时间戳只留数字与 `T:+-`
（`replace(/[^0-9T:+-]/g, '')`），间隔只留数字与 `dhms`
（`replace(/[^0-9dhms]/g, '')`）。保证这两个值**永远不可能闭合标签、也永远不可能从
`<user_message>` 边界里逃出去**。文本改写只动**开标签**，块内内容一字不碰；同名属性
先摘掉再写，重复注入 / 热重载重入都不会堆出两个 `time=`。

**为什么挂两个点**：职责不同，两张表语义也**必须分开**。

| 挂载点 | 干什么 | 记的什么 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ChatBridge.prototype.handleInbound` | **记账**：把 OneBot 事件的 `time`（unix 秒）连同它属于哪个 chat 记下来 | `seenAt`：每次入站都覆盖，含后来被门禁吞掉的未 @ 消息、去重、限流、命令 —— 只回答「这个 chat 最近一次入站是什么时候」 |
| `ChatBridge.prototype.dispatchFollowup` | **注入**：把属性写进交给模型的文本 | `baseline`：注入**成功后**才写，是 `gap` 的基线 —— 只对真正到达模型的消息推进，命令回执之类的投递不污染它 |

`dispatchFollowup` 已被 `rhythm` 挂着（入站合并）。`core/patch.js` 的语义是**后挂的在外层**，
所以本模块必须排在 `scanAll()` 里 rhythm **之后**：这样每条消息各自单独经过本模块（各自注入
自己那一刻的 `time`/`gap`），再由 rhythm 把已注入的几条合并成一批。换过来（本模块在内层）
只会在合并后拿到一整批文本，只能贴一个时间。

chatId 的推导**直接用上游自己的 `chat.js#buildChatId`**，不复刻那个拼法 —— 抄一份就是埋
「上游改了规则而我们还按老规则算」的坑，算错的后果是把时刻记到**别的 chat** 名下。
拿不到该函数时**直接放弃挂载**，不退化成猜。入站时刻还要求像样（2001–2286 年的 unix 秒），
坏值退回当前时刻 —— 一个坏值绝不该给消息盖上胡说八道的钟。

> **已知未补回的一处**：群消息前缀 `[HH:MM 昵称(QQ)]` 不受本模块影响 —— 它用的是**处理时刻**，
> 与 `time` 属性只差几秒，而改写群前缀要啃昵称里的方括号，不划算。

### `mention` 修的是什么

上游 `dsh-onebot-qq/lib/cq.js` 的 `detectMention` 只认两件事：`at` 段指向机器人、或
`reply` 段（引用）指向机器人。**在群里直接喊「云玥」不算。** 这跟真人群聊的习惯不一样 ——
真人被叫名字就知道在叫自己。本模块在 `InboundPipeline.prototype.processInbound` 外面加三条判据：

| 判据 | 干什么 | 默认 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 喊名字 | 正文里出现 `names` 里的任一个（默认 `云玥` / `玥玥` / `Yara`）→ 算被叫到 | 开 |
| `diving` | 被叫醒之后的一小段时间里，群里不 @ 也会搭话，然后自己潜回去 | 关 |
| `topics` | 群里聊到她感兴趣的方向时自己接一句（见下） | 关 |

**怎么表达「她听见了」**：往 `inbound.segments` 追加一个 `{ type: 'at', data: { qq: bot } }`
段 —— 复用上游「被 @」这条现成语义，`detectMention` 的 `at`

plugins.description: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for effort & token insights by date and workspace.DSH 工作量报告插件：按日期与工作区看清「我的付出」与 Token 消耗，含日历热力图 / 时刻分析 / 工作区占比，可导出自包含 HTML 报告。
plugins.readme_text:
# TimeMirror for DSH · Workload Report

> **See your effort and your token spend on the same picture** — by **date** and by **workspace**: a calendar heatmap, time-of-day analysis, workspace share, model usage, and a **one-click self-contained HTML report** you can send straight to a client.
> A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin. Current version: **1.0.5**.

> TimeMirror is a macOS time-distribution app I published on the Mac App Store; this plugin brings the same idea to AI-assisted work. The package/repo keeps the descriptive name `dsh-workload-report` so it can be found in the DSH ecosystem; the brand stays TimeMirror.

[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-workload-report?style=flat-square&logo=npm)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-workload-report)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/github/license/tableau-China/dsh-workload-report?style=flat-square)](./LICENSE)
[![CI](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/tableau-China/dsh-workload-report/ci.yml?branch=main&style=flat-square&label=CI)](https://github.com/tableau-China/dsh-workload-report/actions)
[![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D22-339933?style=flat-square&logo=node.js)](https://nodejs.org)

[中文](./README.zh-CN.md) · English

## What it is

DSH shows stats for the **current session**. This plugin adds the cross-session, cross-project, cross-time view: which dates and which workspaces your effort went to, which hours you were productive, which models consumed the tokens, and what it cost — plus a static report for clients, teammates or monthly reviews.

**Not only cost, but the work behind it.** Active time, active days and turns show what you actually did; tokens and estimated cost show what it consumed. Numbers use the same definitions everywhere, so the dashboard and the exported report agree.

## Install & entry point

```bash
# npm (published package)
dsh plugin add dsh-workload-report

# or straight from GitHub
dsh plugin --profile web add github:tableau-China/dsh-workload-report#main

# or link a local checkout
dsh plugin --profile web add link:$PWD
```

Restart the Web profile after installing. The entry appears at the **bottom of the sidebar**: **Workload report** (**工作量报告** in Chinese). The built client bundle (`lib/client.js`) is committed, so installing from GitHub/npm needs no local build.

Uninstall: `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-workload-report`.

## Data sources & principles

- **Official interfaces only.** Session identity comes from `sessionQuery.listSessions()`; statistics come from the official projections (`sessionProjections`, `sessionProjectionCache`) and, when needed, the official `sessionQuery.observeSession()` cold read. Model and hourly-token dimensions use the official `sessionQuery.readSession()` event log.
- **No storage-format parsing.** The plugin never opens `*.jsonl.zstd`, never parses zstd/JSONL, and never reads the harness's internal projection-cache files. Formats can change between releases; the official seams are the contract.
- **Zero outbound requests by default.** All statistics stay on your machine. The plugin exposes read-only HTTP routes only, and writes only its own local index at `<DSH_HOME>/workload-report/index-v7.json` plus the AI-profile cache in the same directory (both safe to delete; they rebuild). The AI profile calls a model only after you click Generate.
- **Outbound-network cases**: the optional balance chip (`balance.enabled: true`, off by default), where the **host** calls the official `deepseekAccount` service, and the **AI user profile** (included by default, but only a manual click calls the model; aggregate statistics only). See [Privacy](#privacy).
- **No invented numbers.** Unreadable legacy sessions are excluded and counted in the UI; models without an official price show **—** instead of a made-up cost.

## Features (1.0.0)

- **Eight KPIs**: cumulative active time (**net active**, waiting shown on a second line), total tokens (full integer you can verify), model cost, active days, conversations, turns / steps, cache-read share, and the most active model.
- **Daily usage trend**: calendar heatmap (Mon–Sun × Year-Week, colour and bar height = active time) or a bar chart; weekends use a different colour, the peak bar is always labelled, and every calendar cell, bar, weekday total and axis label has its own tooltip.
- **Time of day**: bars default to **token output** (switchable to **turns**); the dots above the bars show **human-message density**. Peak bars are highlighted and labelled; the legend sits on one row.
- **Workspace share**: Top 6 + others donut, switchable between **time** and **tokens**.
- **Model token share**: a compact donut on the dashboard; full model details live in the next tab.
- **Model usage tab**: treemap (area = token share, Top 8 + others), stacked daily trend (Top 6 models), a detail table (share / requests / input / output / cache read / cache-hit rate / estimated cost), metric chips (Token / requests / model time), click-to-filter, and official pricing links. Costs are estimated only for models with official public prices.
- **Top sessions and daily detail**: ratio bars in the main numeric columns (sessions: turns / steps / active / output; daily detail: conversations / turns / active / tokens) and sortable headers on the sessions table. The daily detail table is **expanded by default**, covers the last 31 days, and **paginates at 10 days per page** (no pager unless there is more than one page).
- **By workspace**: the workspace bars carry their own card head with a one-line hint (same structure as the model-usage page).
- **Export a self-contained HTML report**: one file with inline CSS and inline SVG, **no scripts and no external assets**; light/dark themes, custom title/note, optional `anonymize=1` to hide workspace names and session titles. The report mirrors the dashboard: 8 KPIs, a calendar plus a **model token-share donut** (two independent cards whose widths align exactly with the time-of-day / workspace rows below), hourly density dots + turns mini-chart, ratio bars, and the same definitions. A **static range filter** at the top highlights the current range — visual only, with no links. Only official pricing pages are linked.
- **Theme and locale aware**: all colours use host theme tokens (`--dsw-*`), so the dashboard follows the harness light/dark theme; all UI strings are aligned between Chinese and English.
- **AI user profile (included by default, manual trigger)**: a dedicated top-level tab at the **right end of the navigation** (blue-tinted, distinct from the other tabs); the Top sessions tab keeps its sessions table only. It shows a three-line notice first and calls the model only after you click Generate. It generates a headline + 4–6 numeric dimensions + 2–3 advice items + risk from **aggregate statistics only** (window = max(current range, 30 days)) — never conversations, titles, or paths. The same statistics fingerprint reuses the disk cache; any failure falls back to deterministic local rules. See [AI user profile](#ai-user-profile).
- **Fast open**: opening the panel triggers **zero** event-log reads (`readSession`); cold open 25 ms, warm open ~1 ms (measured on an isolated instance). Model folding is driven by background timers, never by opening the panel.

## Screenshots

**By date**: eight KPIs + calendar heatmap + time-of-day analysis with human-message density dots + workspace share

![dashboard by date](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tableau-China/dsh-workload-report/main/assets/dashboard-calendar.png)

**By workspace**: effort on the left, token spend on the right, both bars share one scale

![dashboard by workspace](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tableau-China/dsh-workload-report/main/assets/dashboard-workspace.png)

**The exported report**: one self-contained file, safe to send to a client

![report light](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tableau-China/dsh-workload-report/main/assets/report-light.png)

<details>
<summary>Dark-theme report</summary>

![report dark](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tableau-China/dsh-workload-report/main/assets/report-dark.png)

</details>

plugins.description: 腾讯 WorkBuddy 接入 DeepSeek Harness 的 LLM 插件：浏览器 OAuth 登录、无需 API Key。Tencent WorkBuddy LLM provider plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh).
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-llm-workbuddy-cn

**English** | [中文](README.zh.md)

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`) plugin for **Tencent WorkBuddy**.

Sign in through your browser — **no API key required** — and use WorkBuddy's own model list.

## Features

- **Browser OAuth sign-in** — authorize in a normal browser tab; no API key needed, ever. Sign in to either the China or the international site.
- **Full model catalog** — WorkBuddy's own models, with context windows, output caps, and credit multipliers; server-side additions and removals are picked up automatically.
- **Streaming chat** — responses stream in real time.
- **Tool calls** — function calling, with a clear error when a model does not support it.
- **Reasoning effort** — pick a thinking level for models that support one.
- **Image input** — attach images for vision-capable models (models without vision support may be routed to a different model by the server).
- **Usage indicator** — a quota bar in the Web UI sidebar for both personal and enterprise plans, with an optional custom cap and a configurable danger threshold.

## Compatibility

| Requirement | Version |
| --- | --- |
| DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`) | `>= 0.1.7-rc.1` |

Web UI features such as the settings page, model picker, and usage indicator require the `web` profile.

## Install

Add the plugin to a dsh profile — the `web` profile backs the Web UI:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:wenh56884-wq/dsh-llm-workbuddy
```

The repository ships its compiled `lib/`, so a Git install needs no build step and no
dev dependencies. Installing from a source checkout works too:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-llm-workbuddy
```

## Sign in

Open **Settings → WorkBuddy** in the Web UI and pick a site: **Sign in (China)** for [www.workbuddy.cn](https://www.workbuddy.cn) or **Sign in (Intl)** for [www.workbuddy.ai](https://www.workbuddy.ai). The browser login opens in a new tab; the harness writes the credential automatically. No terminal needed.

The two sites are the same service on different hosts but hold **separate accounts** — one site's account does not work on the other — so the site is chosen per sign-in and recorded with the credential. Every later request goes to the host that issued it. To move to the other site, sign out and sign in again.

Alternatively, sign in from the terminal:

```bash
# A CLI fallback; the Web UI sign-in above is recommended.

# Sign in to the China site (the default; equivalent to --site cn)
dsh plugin --profile web exec dsh-workbuddy-login

# Sign in to the international site
dsh plugin --profile web exec dsh-workbuddy-login --site intl

# Show the signed-in account, its site, and the model list
dsh plugin --profile web exec dsh-workbuddy-login --status

# Remove the stored credential
dsh plugin --profile web exec dsh-workbuddy-login --logout
```

Once signed in, WorkBuddy's models appear in the model picker.

## Build

From a source checkout:

```bash
pnpm install
pnpm run build
```

This compiles the host half with `tsc` and bundles the Web client half with `esbuild`, both into `lib/`.

## Provenance and license

MIT. This plugin is a WorkBuddy adaptation of
[`@shatyuka/dsh-llm-codebuddy`](https://github.com/shatyuka/dsh-llm-codebuddy)
(MIT, © 2026 Shatyuka), which is the original work it derives from: the host
architecture, the browser-OAuth handshake, the model-catalog reader, the
settings page, and the usage indicator are all its author's design. This
repository re-points that client at the WorkBuddy deployments — the site list,
the product token every request identifies itself as, and the provider,
settings, and credential identifiers are WorkBuddy's — and renames it
accordingly. The upstream copyright notice is retained in
[`LICENSE`](./LICENSE) as the license requires.

When the upstream project releases fixes, they can be diffed in against this
tree: the changes here are confined to the identifiers, the two service roots
in `src/constants.ts`, and the catalogue User-Agent documented there.

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin: ask_user_question popup enhancement - selecting an option reveals a per-option note input, sent to the model with the selection
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-question-note

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-question-note.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-question-note)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/dsh-question-note.svg)](LICENSE)

DSH（DeepSeek Harness）「交互式问答」弹窗增强插件：**用户点选某个选项后，在该选项正下方出现一个可选的补充说明输入框；填写的内容与选中的选项一并传给模型。**

## 效果

- 原版弹窗的样式、功能、交互全部保留（组件是官方 `QuestionComposer` 的忠实移植，同一套 CSS 令牌与几何）。
- **补充说明按选项独立存储**：每个被选中的选项下方各有一个自己的补充输入框，互不共享、不随勾选变化移动；取消勾选时输入框隐藏，文字保留（重新勾选会恢复）。单选题换选选项时同理，各选项各记各的。
- 提交时答案格式不变：`{ "answers": [ { "id": "...", "selected": ["选项文字"], "custom": "…" } ] }`。`custom` 的组装规则：单选 = 补充文本原文；多选 = 每个有补充的选项一行、格式「选项文字: 补充」（模型可分清哪句对应哪个选项）；底部自由回答行若有内容追加在最后。不填补充说明时行为与原版完全一致。
- 底部「其他（自定义输入）」行保留，是独立的自由回答入口（单选打字清空已选 = 原版语义；多选与勾选并存 = 原版语义）。
- 计划审查（plan-review）类卡片、审批卡片、超时后续答、已结算回答回看等全部由官方组件处理，本插件不接管。

## 与原版的唯一行为差异

启用后，**单选点选项不再自动跳到下一题**（原版会跳，但那会让用户没机会填写补充说明），而是停留在当前题并展开输入框；在输入框里回车或点「下一题」按钮进入下一题，最后一题回车即提交。

## 实现原理（面向二次开发者）

- 纯客户端 Cordis 插件：浏览器半往 `conversation.composer` 链式槽以 `priority: -10`（官方在默认 0）注册增强版组件，链选举「数值小者先跑、第一个 select 非 null 者胜出」，因此增强版先被询问并接管通用问题卡的渲染；官方插件的卡片注册、倒计时、投影、续答机制原样复用（`src/client/carrier.ts` 以结构化方式消费官方载体对象）。
- 鸭子类型失配时 `select` 返回 null → 安全降级为官方弹窗（功能缺失但弹窗可用）。
- 合并方案零协议改动：宿主端 `userQuestions.answer()` 只校验「每题恰好回答一次」，不禁止 `selected` 与 `custom` 并存；工具结果与超时续答消息都是原样 JSON 透传。

## 开发与安装

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run build     # 产出 lib/index.js（宿主半）与 lib/client.js（浏览器半）
pnpm run check     # 产物语法检查

# 安装到 desktop 配置（会写入 dsh.profile.bundles，需重启 DSH 生效）
dsh plugin --profile desktop add <本目录路径或 npm 包名>
```

## 版本兼容

针对 DSH 0.2.0-rc 族（`@deepseek-ai/*` peer `^0.2.0-rc.1`）。官方弹窗组件内部结构若在后续版本变化，需同步调整 `src/client/carrier.ts` 的结构匹配与 `src/client/composer.tsx` 的移植。

Use the same engine from the browser: - **Vocal Remover & Karaoke** — https://www.sonicaurastudio.com/tools/ai-vocal - **Multitrack Splitter (2/4/6 stems)** — https://www.sonicaurastudio.com/tools/vocal-separation ## Credits Processing uses credits. Get an account and credits at https://www.sonicaurastudio.com ## License MIT

plugins.description: Relabels DSH's normalized WebP request images as image/png so local OpenAI-compatible vision servers (LM Studio, llama.cpp) accept them.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-webp-relabel

Relabels DSH's normalized WebP request images as PNG, so local OpenAI-compatible
vision servers accept them.

English | [简体中文](#简体中文)

## The problem

You paste a screenshot into DeepSeek Harness, pick a local vision model, and the
request dies with:

```
'url' field must be a base64 encoded image.
```

The image is fine. The **label** is not.

## Why it happens

DSH normalizes attachments before storing them, and `dsh-attachment-local` picks
the container from the alpha channel:

```js
const mediaType = hasAlpha ? "image/webp" : "image/jpeg";
```

Screenshots have an alpha channel, so they are stored as WebP. The request-image
ladder only ever emits `alpha:webp` or `opaque:jpeg` — there is no PNG rung and no
configuration option for this.

`dsh-llm-pi-ai` then builds the OpenAI `image_url` payload straight from the
prepared request image:

```js
mimeType: version.mediaType,               // "image/webp"
data: Buffer.from(version.data).toString("base64"),
```

so the wire payload becomes `data:image/webp;base64,...`. LM Studio / llama.cpp
validate that label against a PNG/JPEG allowlist and reject the whole call —
even though the bytes decode perfectly well.

## How it works

Wrap `attachments.readImageRequest()` and return **the same bytes** under a
compatible label:

```js
return { ...version, mediaType: 'image/png' };
```

Measured against LM Studio with `test/diagnostics/relabel-vs-transcode.py`:

| Payload | Result |
|---------|--------|
| webp bytes + `image/webp` | **HTTP 400** `'url' field must be a base64 encoded image.` |
| webp bytes + `image/png`  | **HTTP 200**, image correctly understood |
| png bytes + `image/png`   | HTTP 200 |
| png bytes + `image/webp`  | **HTTP 400** |

Only the label is validated, so no image transcoding is needed.
`test/diagnostics/vision-read.py` confirms the model really sees the image:
it reads a word drawn into a WebP image sent as `image/png`.

Three implementation details matter, and each was verified rather than assumed:

- **Why not rewrite the request messages?** The adapter takes the label from
  `readImageRequest(...).mediaType`, not from the message's
  `ImageBlock.attachment.mediaType`. Rewriting messages changes nothing.
- **Why is a service patch picked up immediately?** The adapter resolves the
  service per call (`resolveAttachments: () => ctx.get("attachments")`), so
  wrapping the method affects the very next request — no restart, no new session.
- **Why the prototype instead of the instance?** `ctx.get()` returns a Cordis
  "traceable" `Proxy` whose `set` trap routes through an extra shadow receiver, so
  an instance-level write is not reliably observable. A property on the prototype
  is always found by the proxy's own descriptor walk.

The model-visible attachment handle text is unaffected: it is built from
`ref.mediaType`, not `version.mediaType`, so it still describes the stored WebP
accurately.

## Install

### From a release tarball (no registry needed)

Download `dsh-webp-relabel-1.0.0.tgz` from the repository's Releases page, then:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add /path/to/dsh-webp-relabel-1.0.0.tgz
```

### From npm

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add dsh-webp-relabel
```

### From a local checkout (verified)

Point the plugin manager at the directory:

```
plugin_manager install_bundle   target = link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-webp-relabel
```

The package is then registered as a link dependency, and its own
`cordis.patch.yml` supplies the loader row — so installing the bundle is the only
step. (Observed on DSH `0.2.1-alpha.2`: `install_bundle` does **not** insert a row
by itself, which is why this bundle ships its own.)

Installing entirely by hand instead? Add the row to your profile's
`cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-webp-relabel
      name: 'dsh-webp-relabel'
```

## Configuration

The bundle already applies these defaults; add this block to your profile's
`cordis.patch.yml` only to override them:

```yaml
- id: dsh-webp-relabel
  name: 'dsh-webp-relabel'
  config:
    from: image/webp     # label to replace (default)
    to: image/png        # replacement label (default)
    debug: true          # log one line per relabeled image (default)
```

## Verify it works

With `debug: true` the DSH console prints one line per relabeled image:

```
[dsh-webp-relabel] relabel #1: image/webp -> image/png (1200x800px, 84521B, ref sha256:...)
```

You can also check the model server's own request log: the payload should contain
`"url": "data:image/png;base64,..."` rather than `image/webp`.

## Disable / uninstall

Disable the plugin in the DSH plugin manager, or set `to: image/webp` in the
config. Either way the original `readImageRequest` is restored from the saved
descriptor — the patch is fully reversible.

## Limitations

- **The label does not match the container.** The bytes stay WebP while the label
  says PNG. This is correct for servers that validate the label (LM Studio,
  llama.cpp). A provider that strictly validates magic bytes would still reject
  it, and the right fix there is real transcoding (`sharp`, `sips`) rather than
  relabeling.
- **It applies to every provider,** because `readImageRequest()` cannot see which
  route the call is going to. Scoping it to local routes would need an extra
  `llm/stream` listener keyed by `options.provider`.
- **It depends on DSH internals:** the `attachments` service, its
  `readImageRequest` method, and that method being a class method on the
  prototype. If a DSH upgrade breaks it, those are the two things to check.

## Development

```sh
npm test
```

Seven cases in `test/plugin-patch.test.mjs`, covering the relabel itself, that the
patch survives a Cordis-style traceable `Proxy`, that non-WebP labels pass
through untouched, that disposing restores the original method (including when it
is inherited from a base class), configurable targets, and idempotent re-apply.

`test/diagnostics/` holds the server-side probes described above.

---

## 简体中文

把 DSH 归一化出来的 WebP 请求图片**重标记为 PNG**，让本地 OpenAI 兼容的视觉模型愿意收下它。

### 问题

在聊天窗口粘贴截图、选一个本地视觉模型，请求直接失败：

```
'url' field must be a base64 encoded image.
```

图片本身没问题，**标签**不对。

### 原因

`dsh-attachment-local` 归一化时按 alpha 通道选容器：

```js
const mediaType = hasAlpha ? "image/webp" : "image/jpeg";
```

截图带 alpha，于是被存成 WebP；请求图档（ladder）只有 `alpha:webp` 和
`opaque:jpeg` 两级，没有 PNG，也没有对应配置项。

`dsh-llm-pi-ai` 再把 `version.mediaType` 直接写进 OpenAI 的 `image_url`：

```js
mimeType: version.mediaType,               // "image/webp"
data: Buffer.from(version.data).toString("base64"),
```

于是线上载荷变成 `data:image/webp;base64,...`。LM Studio / llama.cpp 只允许
PNG/JPEG 标签，整条请求被拒——而字节本身完全能解码。

### 做法

包装 `attachments.readImageRequest()`，**字节一个不改**，只换标签：

```js
return { ...version, mediaType: 'image/png' };
```

实测（`test/diagnostics/relabel-vs-transcode.py`，LM Studio）：

| 载荷 | 结果 |
|------|------|
| webp 字节 + `image/webp` | **HTTP 400** `'url' field must be a base64 encoded image.` |
| webp 字节 + `image/png`  | **HTTP 200**，图片被正确理解 |
| png 字节 + `image/png`   | HTTP 200 |
| png 字节 + `image/webp`  | **HTTP 400** |

即**只校验标签**，所以不需要真的转码。`test/diagnostics/vision-read.py` 进一步确认模型
是"真看见了"：让它读一张以 `image/png` 名义发出的 WebP 图上的字，能读对。

三个关键点都是核实过的，不是推测：

- **为什么不改请求消息？** 适配器的标签来自 `readImageRequest(...).mediaType`，
  不是消息块的 `ImageBlock.attachment.mediaType`，改消息没有任何作用。
- **为什么打补丁立刻生效？** 适配器每次请求都重新解析服务
  （`resolveAttachments: () => ctx.get("attachments")`），所以下一次请求就走新方法，
  不用重启、不用新会话。
- **为什么打在原型而不是实例上？** `ctx.get()` 返回 Cordis 的 "traceable" `Proxy`，
  实例级写入会被 shadow receiver 吞掉；原型属性一定会被 Proxy 的描述符查找命中。

模型可见的图片句柄文案不受影响：它取自 `ref.mediaType` 而不是 `version.mediaType`，
所以仍然准确描述存储的 WebP。

### 安装

本地目录（已实测）：

```
plugin_manager install_bundle   target = link:/绝对路径/dsh-webp-relabel
```

手工安装则在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里加一行：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-webp-relabel
      name: 'dsh-webp-relabel'
```

### 配置（可选）

```yaml
- id: dsh-webp-relabel
  name: 'dsh-webp-relabel'
  config:
    from: image/webp     # 被替换的标签
    to: image/png        # 替换成的标签
    debug: true          # 每张图打印一行日志
```

### 验证

`debug: true` 时 DSH 控制台会打印：

```
[dsh-webp-relabel] relabel #1: image/webp -> image/png

plugins.description: Keeps the DeepSeek Harness context-usage ring honest: an empty usage sample during a retry no longer collapses it to 0%, and its percentage matches the figures beside it.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-context-usage-guard

Keeps the DeepSeek Harness composer's context-usage ring honest: an empty usage
sample during a retry no longer collapses it to `0%`, and its percentage is
typeset at the size of the figures beside it.
**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

[![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/icrefin/dsh-context-usage-guard?style=flat-square)](LICENSE)
[![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/icrefin/dsh-context-usage-guard?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-context-usage-guard/releases/tag/v0.2.0)
[![CI](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/icrefin/dsh-context-usage-guard/ci.yml?branch=main&style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-context-usage-guard/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![Last commit](https://img.shields.io/github/last-commit/icrefin/dsh-context-usage-guard?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-context-usage-guard/commits/main)
[![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/icrefin/dsh-context-usage-guard?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-context-usage-guard/stargazers)
[![PRs welcome](https://img.shields.io/badge/PRs-welcome-brightgreen?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-context-usage-guard/pulls)
[![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D22.17-339933?style=flat-square&logo=node.js)](https://nodejs.org)
[![dsh](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh-0.2.0--rc.2-4B5563?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh)
plugin that repairs two defects in the composer's **context-usage ring** — one in
the value it shows, one in how large that value is drawn:

1. the ring stops dropping to `0%` while a model request is being retried — the
   host half; and
2. the ring's percentage renders at the size of every other figure on its own
   line — the browser half, one stylesheet rule.

## The two bugs it repairs

```
One line, in the composer footer:

  182 steps · 238 tok/s      33.4M tok · Cache hit 94%      ◯ 30%
                                                             ↑
              the ring's 30% was one pixel larger than every other figure

Mid-retry, the same ring read 0% instead of holding the last real reading:

  ◯ 0%   →   ◯ 6%
```

### The ring collapses to `0%` while a request is being retried

The ring renders the session projection `contextPressure`. That projection takes
the **newest usage sample** as the current prompt size and publishes:

```text
pressureTokens  = usage.inputTokens + cacheReadTokens + cacheWriteTokens
projectedTokens = max(0, pressureTokens + surfaceTokens - sampledSurfaceTokens)
```

A model call that fails before the provider reports anything — a `429`, a rate
limit, a timeout, a transport error, or a user cancellation — still ends its
stream with a `usage` chunk:

```jsonc
[ { "type": "chunk", "chunk": { "type": "usage",  "usage": { "inputTokens": 0, "outputTokens": 0, "totalTokens": 0 } } },
  { "type": "chunk", "chunk": { "type": "finish", "reason": { "kind": "error",
      "failure": { "code": "RATE_LIMIT", "message": "429: token_capacity_exceeded" } } } } ]
```

The adapter's accumulator starts at zero and nothing ever overwrote it, so this
sample is *empty*, not a measurement. But it is the newest sample, so
`pressureTokens` becomes `0`, and because the sample is stamped at the current
surface total the projection publishes `projectedTokens: 0`. `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-retry`
then retries the same step — six times in the session this plugin was written
from — and the ring reads `0%` for the whole storm, misreporting a context that
never changed.

Measured against the shipped `contextPressure` fold, replaying that session's
real events (`test/fold.spec.ts`):

| Replay | `pressureTokens` | `projectedTokens` | Ring |
|---|---|---|---|
| after the last successful call, before the retry | 64 389 | 64 389 | `6%` |
| the failed attempt, **unguarded** | 0 | 0 | `0%` ← the symptom |
| the failed attempt, **guarded** | 64 389 | 64 389 | `6%` |
| the retried step finally succeeds | 64 575 | 64 575 | `6%` |

### The percentage is one pixel larger than the figures beside it

The same footer band holds the session statistics and the ring, and the two
shipped stylesheets disagree by one pixel about how big a figure is:

```css
/* @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-chat — StatsPills.module.css, the pills */
.bOPqQW_root    { font-size: calc(var(--dsh-content-font-size-secondary,13px) - 1px) }

/* @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-conversation — ContextMeter.module.css, the ring */
.JObwrW_trigger { font-size: var(--dsh-content-font-size-secondary,13px) }
```

Both prefixes are content-hashed per build — the pair above is what the
`0.2.0-rc.2` packages installed here carry; the *declarations* are what matters,
and `test/meter-typography.spec.ts` re-reads them from the installed packages
rather than trusting this block.

So `30%` renders about 8% larger than the `182 steps`, `238 tok/s`, `33.4M tok`
and `Cache hit 94%` beside it, which reads as a different typeface. Measured on a
screenshot of that line: every other figure has a 12 px cap height, the ring's
has 13–14 px — a ratio of 1.08, exactly `13 ÷ 12`. The meter's own breakdown
panel is already `12px`, so the trigger is the outlier.

## What the plugin does

| Half | Surface | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| Host | `llm/stream` waterfall | one listener that withholds an empty usage sample belonging to a failed attempt, so the projection keeps its last real reading |
| Browser | the document `head` | one self-tagged stylesheet rule that puts the meter's percentage at the statistics pills' figure size |

Neither half adds a page, a route, a settings section or a stored file. The host
half declares `inject: ['llm']`, so the LLM service must exist first, and it
registers inside `ctx.effect`: cordis runs the disposer on unload, when the
profile patch disables the row, or at shutdown — a bare `ctx.on` would leak the
listener past unload.

One rule, applied to the chunk stream of every model call:

> A usage sample whose **every reported count is zero** measures nothing. When it
> belongs to an attempt that ended in `error` or `aborted`, it is dropped, so the
> previous real reading stands.

Everything else passes through untouched:

- **a successful completion**, whatever it reports — `stop`, `tool-calls` and
  `max-tokens` are authoritative provider answers, so a zero there is left for
  the consumer to judge;
- **a failed attempt that did report something** — a partial call can carry real
  input counts, so no billed counter is ever discarded;
- **stream shape, order and timing** — the withheld sample is the only chunk that
  moves; visible deltas keep their order and the terminal `finish` the retry
  executor reads is preserved.

## How the fix works

### Host half: the sample that decides the reading never lands

The wrapper holds **at most one** `usage` chunk and releases it immediately
before the next chunk, so the only chunk whose position can change is the sample
that decides the outcome. A stream that ends without its terminal `finish` still
releases a held sample — the guard never swallows information it did not
positively decide to drop. Withholding the chunk is legal in the stream protocol:
`usage` may appear at most once and is never required, `BlockAssembler.usage`
stays `undefined` without it, and the agent loop already omits the durable
event's `usage` field rather than failing. Token accounting is unaffected — the
projection's usage fold adds an empty sample's buckets as zero anyway, which
`test/fold.spec.ts` pins directly.

### Browser half: one stylesheet rule

The browser half adds one stylesheet rule that repeats the statistics
declaration verbatim:

```css
button[aria-haspopup="dialog"]:has(> svg > circle) {
  font-size: calc(var(--dsh-content-font-size-secondary,13px) - 1px);
}
```

- **Structural selector, not a class name.** The meter's button is the only
  dialog-opening control whose icon *is* the ring — an inline `<svg>` with
  `<circle>` children — while the statistics pills draw `<path>` icons. A build
  that re-hashes every class

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 插件：把多台 SSH 服务器存成主机清单，agent 在会话里按主机名引用（命令执行 + 远端文件读写）；设置界面管理，支持密钥/密码登录，会话窗口「+」菜单可选主机。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-ssh-hosts

[![test](https://github.com/alfredhuang211/dsh-ssh-hosts/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/alfredhuang211/dsh-ssh-hosts/actions/workflows/test.yml)
[![license: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)

给 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）加一组 SSH 工具：**把若干台服务器存成一份主机清单，agent 在会话里用主机名引用它们** —— 执行命令、读文件、写文件、改文件、列目录。

- 凭据只存**怎么连**（host / user / identityFile / 跳板），不存密码、不存密钥内容；
- 认证、known_hosts、ssh-agent 全部交给系统 OpenSSH，插件不重新实现加密；
- 多机：同时配置 N 台，一次调用指定一台；会话里可以 `ssh_use` 设默认机；
- **图形界面管理**：在 `设置 → 插件 → dsh-ssh-hosts`（或设置侧栏「SSH 主机」）里新增/编辑/删除主机、测连通性、设默认机；界面写的就是那份 YAML，改完立即生效，不用重启；
- 与本地同名工具语义一致（`read` 的 offset/limit 是行号，`edit` 要求 oldString 唯一）。

## 装

### 方式零：直接从 GitHub

```bash
git clone https://github.com/alfredhuang211/dsh-ssh-hosts.git
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-ssh-hosts      # 桌面版则在「设置 → 插件」里选这个目录
```

[Releases](https://github.com/alfredhuang211/dsh-ssh-hosts/releases) 里也有打包好的 `dsh-ssh-hosts-x.y.z.tgz`，适合离线安装或内网分发。

### 方式一：桌面 App / CLI 的插件安装（推荐）

```bash
# CLI：把本目录（或 npm pack 出的 tgz）装进某个 profile
dsh plugin --profile web add /绝对路径/plugin-dev/ssh-hosts
```

装完 `dsh web --dump-config | grep -A2 ssh-hosts` 应该能看到：

```
# == dsh-ssh-hosts
- id: ssh-hosts
  name: dsh-ssh-hosts
```

桌面版也可以在 **设置 → 插件** 里安装同一个 tgz / 目录；本插件声明了 `dsh.bundle.patch`，安装后会自动作为一层 bundle 参与 profile 组装（`insert` 一行 `id: ssh-hosts`）。

> 桌面 App 自己的 `desktop` profile 由 Electron 独占：`dsh plugin --profile desktop ...` 会被拒绝（`profile "desktop" is managed exclusively by the Electron application`）。要装进桌面 App，请从 App 内的插件界面装，或者按 App 写 package.json 的方式加 `link:`/依赖后由 App 重启加载 —— 别去手改它的 profile 状态。

### 方式二：手写 patch 行

不想用它自带的 bundle patch、或想在别人的 profile 里手动挂，就在 `~/.dsh/profiles/<name>/cordis.patch.yml`（或 `~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml`）里加：

```yaml
- insert:
  - id: 'ssh-hosts'
    name: 'dsh-ssh-hosts'      # 也可以写 file:///绝对路径/plugin-dev/ssh-hosts/lib/index.js
    config:
      defaultHost: web-01
```

`config` 全部字段都有默认值，只写需要覆盖的即可。

## 配置

主机清单有两条路，用的是**同一份数据**（`ssh-hosts.yaml`）：

- **图形界面（推荐）**：装好后打开 `设置 → 插件 → dsh-ssh-hosts`（或设置侧栏的「SSH 主机」），在那里新增/编辑/删除主机、测试连通性、设默认机。界面写的就是下面这个 YAML，写完立即重载，**不用重启**。
- **手工编辑**：直接改 YAML；改完在界面上点「重新读取」，或重启。

![设置里的 SSH 主机卡片（窄列 ~340px）](docs/settings-card.png)

*窄列下的样子：一台主机一个块，事实在上、操作在下，长路径自己断行。*

界面能做的事：

| 能力 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| 新增 / 编辑 / 删除 / 设默认 | 字段校验与服务端同一套规则：错了当场红框标出**并说明怎么改**，不用等一次 400 |
| 测试连接 | 结果就地显示在那台主机下面（成功给耗时与远端首行，失败给 exit code 与原因），不用去翻底部日志 |
| 删除二次确认 | 在块内确认，并说清会连带清掉什么（例如「已存密码也一并清除」），不可撤销 |
| 过滤 | 主机多了按名称 / 地址 / 标签 / 备注 / 认证方式过滤，并显示匹配台数 |
| 键盘 | `Enter` 保存、`Esc` 取消；错误是 `role="alert"`、日志是 `aria-live`，读屏能听到 |
| 密码 | 只写不读：显示「已保存（来自哪一层）」或「未设置」，输入可显示/隐藏，清除要再确认一次 |
| 空状态 | 没有主机时直接给「新增主机」按钮 + 手工编辑提示，不用猜下一步做什么 |

### 1. 主机清单（界面与手工共用的那份文件）

```bash
cp ssh-hosts.example.yaml ~/.dsh/ssh-hosts.yaml
chmod 600 ~/.dsh/ssh-hosts.yaml     # 权限不是 0600 会被拒绝加载
$EDITOR ~/.dsh/ssh-hosts.yaml
```

文件**不存在**时插件照常启动、界面照常打开，只是清单为空：在界面上新增第一台主机就会把文件建出来（0600）。文件存在但坏掉（YAML 语法错、`hosts` 不是数组、权限过宽）仍然是**装载期硬失败** —— 那是真配置错误，越早炸越好。

```yaml
version: 1

hosts:
  - name: web-01                    # ← agent 在会话里引用的名字
    host: 10.0.0.11
    user: deploy
    identityFile: ~/.ssh/id_ed25519 # 密钥登录；必须 0600。省略 = 交给 ssh-agent/默认密钥
    defaultWorkdir: /srv/app
    description: 生产 Web（Nginx）
    tags: [prod, web]
    port: 22
    proxyJump: bastion              # 本清单里的 name，或 user@host:port
    connectTimeoutSec: 15
    keepAliveSec: 30
    readOnly: true                  # 拒绝 ssh_write / ssh_edit

  - name: db-01
    host: 10.0.0.12
    user: root
    passwordRef: DSH_SSH_HOSTS_PASSWORD_DB_01   # 密码登录：只写「凭据名」，不写密码
    tags: [prod, db]
```

字段全部可选（`name` / `host` 必填），**未知字段会直接报错**，拼错不会被静默忽略。清单里写 `password:` / `passphrase:` 会被专门拒绝，并告诉你该怎么放密码。

### 1.1 登录方式：密钥 / 密码 / ssh-agent

| 方式 | 清单里怎么写 | 怎么设置 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **密钥**（推荐） | `identityFile: ~/.ssh/id_ed25519` | 界面「登录方式 → 密钥文件」，填路径即可（文件必须存在且 0600） |
| **密码** | `passwordRef: DSH_SSH_HOSTS_PASSWORD_XXX` | 界面「登录方式 → 密码」，在密码框里填一次；插件把值交给 DSH 凭据库，清单里只留引用名 |
| **密钥优先、密码兜底** | 两个字段都给 | 界面选「密钥优先，密码兜底」 |
| **ssh-agent / 默认密钥** | 两个字段都不给 | 界面选「ssh-agent / 默认密钥」，交给 OpenSSH 自己挑 |

密码**不进清单文件**：`$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml`（0600，DSH 自己的凭据库）存值，`ssh-hosts.yaml` 只存名字。所以清单可以安全地备份/分享；界面、HTTP 响应、模型可见的工具输出里都**只回报「有没有、来自哪一层」**，永远不回显密码。删主机或点「清除已存密码」会顺手把凭据库里的那条删掉，不留孤儿。

密码登录的实现是 OpenSSH 官方路子（`SSH_ASKPASS` + 一次性 0600 文件）：密码不进命令行参数、不进环境变量、不进日志，`ps` 里看不到；每次调用前现解析、用完即删，所以改完密码**下一次调用就生效**，不用重启。没有凭据服务的 profile（极少见）插件照常工作，只是密码主机连不上，界面会说明原因。

### 2. 图形界面背后的 HTTP 路由

界面（浏览器半边）通过同源路由读写清单，也**可以只用 curl**（同一个 web server，CSRF/Host 校验与其它 GUI 接口一致）：

| 方法 | 路径 | 作用 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET | `/ssh-hosts/hosts` | 清单 + 文件信息 + 是否可写 + 默认机 |
| POST | `/ssh-hosts/hosts` | 新增/修改一台（`{ host: {...}, previousName?, password?, clearPassword? }`，改名靠 `previousName`；`password` 只进不出，`clearPassword: true` 清除） |
| POST | `/ssh-hosts/hosts/delete` | 删除（`{ name }`） |
| POST | `/ssh-hosts/default` | 设/清默认机（`{ name }`，空串清除） |
| POST | `/ssh-hosts/reload` | 重新读盘（手工改完文件点这个） |
| POST | `/ssh-hosts/test` | 真实 SSH 连上去跑一条只读命令 |

返回统一是 `{ ok: true, value }` 或 `{ ok: false, error: { code, message } }`；`400` 参数/文件内容有误、`409` 清单来自 config 不可写、`404` 主机不存在、`501` 当前 profile 没有凭据服务（存不了密码）、`403/401` 未过 Host/来源/登录校验。写入顺序是**先校验、再原子写、再重载**，重载失败会把文件回滚成写之前的字节 —— 界面上一次误操作不会让正在跑的会话失去目标机。

### 3. 插件 config

| 字段 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hostsFile` | `$DSH_HOME/ssh-hosts.yaml` | 清单路径；相对路径按 `$DSH_HOME` 解析 |
| `defaultHost` | 空 | 没指定 host、本会话也没 `ssh_use` 过时用的默认机 |
| `knownHostsFile` | 空（OpenSSH 默认） | 自定义 known_hosts 路径 |
| `strictHostKeyChecking` | `accept-new` | `accept-new` / `yes` / `no` |
| `connectTimeoutSec` | 10 | 建连超时 |
| `timeoutMs` | 60000 | 单条命令默认超时 |
| `maxOutputBytes` | 262144 | stdout/stderr 各自保留上限（超出保尾并标记截断） |
| `maxReadBytes` | 8388608 | 单文件读取上限 |
| `controlPersistSec` | 300 | 连接复用时长；0 = 每次重建连 |
| `allow` / `deny` | `[]` | `ssh_run` 命令正则白/黑名单（deny 优先） |
| `hosts` | `[]` | 就地声明主机（非空时忽略 `hostsFile`） |

这些标量字段都是 DSH 的 **volatile** 字段：在设置页改完**不用重启插件**，下一次工具调用就用新值（插件每次读配置都解包 volatile 引用）。`hosts` 例外 —— 它是部署方声明，改了要重启；而且它非空时界面变成只读，避免「设置页改一半、YAML 改一半」。

## 用：添加完主机，怎么引用

**在会话窗口里直接选**（新增，最快）：点输入框左边的 **「+」**，在命令菜单里选 **`ssh`** → 弹出主机列表（带 `user@host`、标签、认证方式，并标出本会话当前在用哪台）→ 点一台即可。它设的是**本会话**默认主机（和 `ssh_use` 同一条路径、同一份状态），之后你在这个会话里说「执行 uname -a」就直接落到那台机器。也可以手打 `/ssh <主机名>`，`/ssh clear` 清除。

> 一个平台规则：输入框里**已经有内容**时，「+」菜单只列不带参数的命令（`ssh` 带参数提示，所以那时不显示）—— 这是 DSH 对斜杠菜单的统一约定，`/permission` 等命令同样如此。想在已有草稿上换机器，先选中草稿前的空白再点「+」，或直接手打 `/ssh <主机名>`。

**在会话里直接说人话也行**（最常用）：

```
在 web-01 上执行 systemctl status nginx
看一下 db-01 的 /etc/mysql/my.cnf
把 web-01 的 /srv/app/.env 里 PORT=8080 改成 PORT=9090
```

agent 会先 `ssh_hosts()` 看清单，再带上 `host: "web-01"` 调用对应工具。主机名就是你在界面里填的「名称」。

**显式调用**（想知道底层发生了什么时）：

```
ssh_hosts()                                        → 列主机（含 auth 方式、tags、默认目录）
ssh_use({ host: "web-01" })                        → 设为本会话默认机，之后可以省略 host
ssh_run({ command: "uname -a" })                   → 在默认机上跑
ssh_run({ host: "db-01", command: "df -h" })       → 指定机器跑（不依赖默认机）
ssh_read({ host: "web-01", path: "/etc/nginx/nginx.conf", offset: 1, limit: 40 })
ssh_write({ host: "web-01", path: "/tmp/hello.txt", content: "hi\n" })
ssh_edit({ host: "web-01", path: "/srv/app/.env", oldString: "PORT=8080", newString: "PORT=9090" })
ssh_ls({ host: "web-01", path: "/srv/app" })
```

主机解析优先级：**显式 `host` 参数 → 本会话 `ssh_use` → 界面设的默认机 → `config.defaultHost` → 报错并列出可用主机**（绝不再猜一台）。界面上点「设为默认」写的就是第三档；默认机是**全局**的，`ssh_use` 是**本会话**的。

模型看到的 7 个工具：

| 工具 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `ssh_hosts` | 列出可用主机（含 tags / 说明 / 默认目录 / 认证方式），可按 tag 过滤；`defaultHost` + `defaultSource` 告诉你本次调用实际会用哪台 |
| `ssh_use` | 读/设本会话默认主机，之后其它工具可省略 `host` |
| `ssh_run` | 执行命令，返回 exitCode / stdout / stderr（**非零退出是正常结果**） |
| `ssh_read` | 读文本文件，可给行号区间 |
| `ssh_write` | 整文件写入（远端临时文件 + rename 原子替换，保留原权限） |
| `ssh_edit` | 精确字符串替换（要求唯一匹配，除非 `replaceAll`） |
| `ssh_ls` | 列目录（类型/权限/大小/时间） |

主机解析优先级：**显式 `host` 参数 → 本会话 `ssh_use` → 界面设的默认机 → `config.defaultHost` → 报错并列出可用主机**（绝不再猜一台）。

三种方式的作用域要分清：**会话窗口的「+ → ssh」和 `ssh_use` 是「本会话」**（互不干扰，换会话就没了）；**设置页的「设为默认」是全局**（所有没有会话默认的会话都用它）。`ssh_hosts` 报的 `defaultHost` 是**本次调用实际会用的那台**（会话默认 → 全局默认 → `config.defaultHost`），`defaultSource` 告诉你是哪一档。
